name: Solbrand Dagger
description: This dagger's blade is etched with the Division of Lumination's sunburst sigil and sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. Attacks with this weapon deal an extra 1 fire damage on a hit. DOL soldiers were issued these as sidearms; the warmth is said to keep morale high on long patrols.

name: Whispering Bolt Quiver
description: A quiver of 20 crossbow bolts that whistle faintly as they fly, audible only to the target. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened until the end of its next turn. The fear is brief but humiliating.

name: Dustwalker's Shortbow
description: This bow requires no arrows — it generates spectral shafts of compressed air when drawn, with a range of 60/120 ft dealing 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Militia scouts in the outer reaches favour it for its silence and the fact that it never runs dry.

name: Cinder Handaxe
description: The head of this axe smoulders perpetually without burning the haft, leaving a brief trail of embers when thrown. It deals an extra 1 fire damage on a hit and returns to your hand immediately after a thrown attack.

name: Tanner's Notched Cleaver
description: A heavy butcher's blade that functions as a handaxe. Against Beasts it deals an extra 1 slashing damage, and you have advantage on checks made to carve, skin or butcher a carcass.

name: Quiet Sling of the Orchard
description: A sling of braided orchard twine. Shots fired from it make no sound in flight, and a creature struck cannot pinpoint your location by hearing alone until the end of its next turn.

name: Driftwood Club
description: Sea-worn and salt-hardened. The club floats, never rots, and deals an extra 1 bludgeoning damage to creatures with a swimming speed.

name: Pike of the Patient Line
description: A soldier's pike. If you have not moved this turn, your first attack with it is made with advantage against a creature that moved within 10 feet of you.

name: Glassbite Shortsword
description: The edge is set with chips of volcanic glass. On a critical hit, a shard lodges in the wound and the target takes 1 slashing damage at the start of its next turn.

name: Warding Buckler-Spike
description: A spike bolted to a shield boss, usable as a dagger. While wielding it you may use a reaction to deal 1 piercing damage to a creature that hits you with a melee attack.

name: Fisher's Barbed Trident
description: A trident with reversed barbs. A creature hit by it takes an extra 1 piercing damage if it moves willingly out of your reach before the end of its next turn.

name: Hunting Bow of the Long Dusk
description: A plain yew shortbow. In dim light or darkness you ignore the disadvantage imposed by lightly obscured conditions when making ranged attacks with it.

name: Mason's Maul
description: A stonecutter's maul usable as a warhammer. It deals double damage to objects and structures, and you have advantage on Strength checks made to break stone.

name: Ratter's Dagger
description: A thin blade favoured by cellar-men. Against creatures of Small size or smaller it scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

name: Whipcord Lash
description: A whip of braided sinew. As a bonus action you may attempt to snatch an unattended object weighing 1 pound or less from up to 10 feet away.

name: Hearthiron Skillet
description: A cast-iron pan that counts as a mace. It never rusts, heats food placed in it to serving temperature in one minute, and rings loudly when it strikes metal.

name: Signalman's Spear
description: The haft is wound with coloured cord. As an action you may raise it and cause its tip to flare with coloured light visible for one mile, lasting one minute.

name: Thresher's Flail
description: A farm flail pressed into service. When you hit two different creatures with it in the same turn, the second attack deals an extra 1 bludgeoning damage.

name: Splinter Dart Case
description: Holds 20 darts of hardened resin. A dart that hits shatters harmlessly, but the target has disadvantage on its next Stealth check as the pale dust clings to it.

name: Frostbitten Hand Axe
description: The head is permanently rimed. It deals 1 cold damage instead of 1 slashing when you choose, and liquid it is dipped into freezes to a depth of one inch.

name: Ledgerkeeper's Letter-Knife
description: A slender dagger. It cuts paper, cord, wax and leather as though they were not there, and you have advantage on checks to open a sealed document without damaging it.

name: Boarspear of the Low Wood
description: A crossguard below the blade stops a charging foe. When a creature moves into your reach and you hit it with a readied attack, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength save or stop moving.

name: Chipped Gladius of the Ninth
description: An old legionary shortsword. While another creature you can see is within 5 feet of you and wielding a weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls with it.

name: Nightwatch Lantern-Hook
description: A boat hook usable as a quarterstaff. A hooded lantern may be fixed to one end, leaving both hands free to fight while it burns.

name: Sparrow-Fletched Arrows
description: A bundle of 20 arrows. Each ignores the penalty for firing at long range, but shatters on impact whether it hits or misses.

name: Bruiser's Knuckles
description: Weighted leather wraps. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage and count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance.

name: Saltrusted Cutlass
description: Pitted but serviceable. Against a creature that is Grappled, Restrained or Prone, it deals an extra 1 slashing damage.

name: Tinker's Pry-Bar
description: Counts as a club. You have advantage on Strength checks to force open doors, lids and crates, and on saves against being disarmed of it.

name: Candlewick Rapier
description: A duelling blade with a hollow guard. As a bonus action you may light or snuff a candle, torch or lantern within 5 feet without touching it.

name: Herder's Crook-Staff
description: A quarterstaff with a hooked head. You have advantage on checks to trip, hook or haul a creature of Medium size or smaller that is within 10 feet.

name: Dustpan Shortbow
description: Strung with grey gut. Once per short rest, an arrow fired from it bursts into a harmless cloud of dust on impact, lightly obscuring a 5-foot cube for one round.

name: Gravetender's Spade
description: A sharpened spade counting as a battleaxe. It digs a 5-foot cube of loose earth in one minute, and deals an extra 1 damage to Undead.

name: Chandler's Scissor-Blades
description: Twin short blades used as a pair of daggers. When you take the Attack action with one, drawing the other costs no part of your turn.

name: Riverman's Gaff
description: A long hooked pole counting as a spear with reach. You may use it to drag a willing or unconscious Medium creature 5 feet toward you as an action.

name: Oathbound Practice Sword
description: A blunted longsword that deals bludgeoning damage and cannot reduce a creature below 1 hit point. Training with it grants advantage on checks made to teach swordplay.

name: Cinderwood Javelins
description: A sheaf of 5 javelins of charred wood. Each deals 1 fire damage in addition to its normal damage, then is consumed in a puff of ash.

name: Tollkeeper's Cudgel
description: A weighted club. Once per day, when you hit a creature that has attempted to deceive you within the last hour, it takes an extra 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

name: Needle of the Quiet Room
description: A dagger that makes no sound when drawn, sheathed, or when it strikes. It cannot be heard, though the wound it leaves is ordinary.

name: Scrapper's Chain
description: Three feet of weighted chain counting as a flail. On a hit you may forgo 1 damage to impose a -1 penalty on the target's next attack roll before the end of its turn.

name: Moonveil Shortblade
description: Forged with suppressed lunar alloys, this shortsword deals an extra 1d4 psychic damage on a hit. While drawn under moonlight, the wielder has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. DOL inspectors confiscate these on sight.

name: Shard Flail of Echo
description: The head of this flail is studded with Echo Vein crystals that resonate on impact. On a critical hit, all creatures within 10 feet of the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be Deafened until the end of their next turn. The crystals hum softly even at rest.

name: Splitjaw Crossbow
description: This light crossbow fires two bolts simultaneously at the same target using one bolt of ammunition — roll both attacks. On a hit with both, the target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. The twin firing mechanisms click like teeth.

name: Chainwhip of the Overseer
description: A DOL-forged whip with 15-foot reach that deals 1d6 slashing damage. On a hit, the target is Grappled (escape DC 14) until you attack another creature. DOL wardens used these for crowd suppression during the Luminary Edicts.

name: Bladesong Rapier
description: This rapier hums at a frequency that disrupts concentration — when you deal damage with it, the target must make a DC 13 Concentration check instead of the normal DC. The tone is almost musical, which makes it stranger to face.

name: Whitewater Trident
description: A +1 trident. While submerged or in heavy rain you also gain a +1 bonus to AC, and you can breathe water for up to 10 minutes per day.

name: Hollowpoint Crossbow
description: A +1 heavy crossbow. On a critical hit the bolt punches clean through: a creature directly behind the target within 5 feet takes 1d8 piercing damage.

name: Lamplighter's Glaive
description: A +1 glaive whose blade burns with cold white fire, shedding bright light in 15 feet. The flame can be doused or raised as a bonus action, and deals an extra 1d4 fire damage while lit.

name: Shrike's Beak
description: A +1 war pick. Against a creature that is Restrained, Grappled or pinned against a surface, your attacks score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.

name: Greenbriar Longbow
description: A +1 longbow of living wood. Once per short rest, an arrow you fire sprouts grasping creepers: the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be Restrained until it escapes.

name: Duellist's Answer
description: A +1 rapier. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may use your reaction to make an attack against it with this weapon. Once per short rest.

name: Quarryman's Breaker
description: A +1 maul. Against Constructs and objects it deals an extra 1d8 bludgeoning damage, and it can shatter a 5-foot section of unworked stone with one minute of effort.

name: Sleetfang Scimitar
description: A +1 scimitar sheathed in frost. A creature hit by it has its speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Hornet Quiver
description: Produces 10 +1 arrows each dawn; unused arrows vanish at the next sunrise. Each hums angrily in flight, and a creature struck has disadvantage on Concentration saves until the end of its turn.

name: Pressgang Net
description: A weighted net of black cord. A creature Restrained by it has disadvantage on checks to escape, and the net cannot be cut by nonmagical blades.

name: Debtor's Due
description: A +1 dagger. If the target of your attack has dealt damage to you since the end of your last turn, the attack deals an extra 1d6 piercing damage.

name: Ashfall Warhammer
description: A +1 warhammer. On a hit, a cloud of fine ash bursts out: the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or be unable to speak clearly until the end of its next turn.

name: Keelbreaker Boarding Axe
description: A +1 battleaxe. It deals triple damage to ships, carts, doors and similar wooden structures, and floats if dropped in water.

name: Thorn of the Second Watch
description: A +1 shortsword. While you are the only creature awake within 30 feet, it sheds a faint warning glow when a hostile creature comes within 60 feet.

name: Hush Bolt Repeater
description: A +1 hand crossbow that fires silently. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by it falls without a sound, and the shot cannot be heard beyond 10 feet.

name: Magnet-Head Flail
description: A +1 flail. On a hit against a creature wearing metal armour or wielding a metal weapon, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be pulled 5 feet toward you.

name: Verdant Sickle
description: A +1 sickle. Once per day, a creature you reduce to 0 hit points with it causes grass and flowers to erupt in a 10-foot radius, which counts as difficult terrain for one hour.

name: Tideturn Cutlass
description: A +1 scimitar. Once per short rest, when you hit a creature, you may shove it 10 feet in any horizontal direction as though caught by a wave.

name: Marksman's Patience
description: A +1 longbow. If you did not move on your turn, your attacks with it ignore half cover and three-quarters cover.

name: Bannerman's Spear
description: A +1 spear flying a small pennant. Allies within 10 feet of you have advantage on saving throws against being Frightened.

name: Lockjaw Mancatcher
description: A polearm with a sprung collar, reach 10 feet. On a hit the target must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity save or be Grappled; you can drag it but cannot attack with the weapon while it holds.

name: Emberdust Pouch
description: Thrown as an improvised weapon with a range of 20/60. On impact it bursts in a 5-foot radius, dealing 2d4 fire damage; a DC 13 Dexterity save halves. It refills at dawn.

name: Pale Reeve's Longsword
description: A +1 longsword. Against Undead it deals an extra 1d6 radiant damage and sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius whenever one is within 30 feet.

name: Barbwire Garrote
description: Against a creature that cannot see you, this deals 2d6 slashing damage on a hit and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution save or be unable to speak for one minute.

name: Stormcall Javelin
description: A +1 javelin. Once per day, when thrown, it strikes with a thunderclap: the target and creatures within 5 feet take 1d6 thunder damage, DC 13 Constitution save for none.

name: Vaultcracker's Pick
description: A +1 light hammer. It grants advantage on checks made to break locks, hinges and strongboxes, and such checks make no more noise than a tap.

name: Wheelspoke Staff
description: A +1 quarterstaff. When you take the Dodge action, you may make one attack with it as a bonus action.

name: Wolfsbane Spear
description: A +1 spear of silvered ash. Against shapechangers and lycanthropes it deals an extra 1d8 damage and prevents them from changing shape until the end of their next turn.

name: Gloomfletch Arrows
description: A quiver of 10 black arrows. Each creates a 5-foot cube of magical darkness where it lands, lasting one minute. They replenish at dawn.

name: Toll of the Old Gate
description: A +1 morningstar. Once per short rest, on a hit, it rings like a struck bell: all creatures within 20 feet that can hear it must make a DC 13 Constitution save or be Deafened for one minute.

name: Fencer's Second Blade
description: A +1 dagger designed for the off hand. When you make a two-weapon attack with it, add your ability modifier to the damage even if you normally could not.

name: Duskforged Longsword
description: A +1 longsword whose blade is dark as a clouded sky, dealing an extra 1d6 necrotic damage on a hit. While attuned to it, you can see normally in magical darkness out to 60 feet. The DOL classified its origin as Shadowsong remnant technology.

name: Tre Illium Spear
description: An artefact recovered from the ruins of Tre Illium — a +1 spear that deals an extra 2d4 radiant damage when thrown, with doubled range (40/160 ft). The spear returns to your hand at the end of your turn. Its tip is engraved in a language nobody alive can read.

name: Sanguine Greatsword
description: This +1 greatsword deals an extra 1d6 necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. Attuned wielders find their appetite for food slowly replaced by something else.

name: Veilpiercer Longbow
description: A +1 longbow that ignores half and three-quarters cover. Once per day, you can fire an arrow that passes through solid matter to strike a target you know the location of within range. The silver trails arrows leave in the air linger for several seconds.

name: Bonecaller's Mace
description: A +1 mace carved from a single femur, lacquered black. When it reduces a creature to 0 hit points, you can use a reaction to animate the corpse as a skeleton under your command for 1 hour (max 3 at once).

name: Splitter — The Divided Axe
description: A +2 battleaxe that, once per turn on a hit, deals an extra 1d8 slashing damage and forces the target to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked Prone. Named for the DOL's policy of dividing conquered territories — a dark joke among resistance fighters.

name: Reaper's Tally
description: A +2 glaive with a scythe-curved head. Each creature it reduces to 0 hit points adds a notch to the haft; while three or more notches remain, you gain a +10 bonus to speed. Notches clear at dawn.

name: Thunderhead Maul
description: A +2 maul. On a critical hit, thunder erupts in a 15-foot radius: creatures other than you take 3d6 thunder damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Strength save or be knocked Prone.

name: Serpentbite Whip
description: A +2 whip with reach 15 feet. On a hit the target must make a DC 15 Constitution save or take 2d6 poison damage and be Poisoned until the end of its next turn.

name: Riftcut Shortsword
description: A +2 shortsword. Once per short rest, immediately after hitting a creature, you may teleport to an unoccupied space within 15 feet that you can see.

name: Gale-Strung Longbow
description: A +2 longbow. Its range is doubled, arrows fired from it are unaffected by wind or weather, and once per day you may fire an arrow that curves around total cover to strike a target you have seen in the last minute.

name: The Patient Guest
description: A +2 dagger. The first attack you make with it against a creature that has not yet acted in combat deals an extra 4d6 piercing damage.

name: Magma Core Warhammer
description: A +2 warhammer with a glowing seam. It deals an extra 2d6 fire damage, and on a critical hit the target begins burning, taking 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until someone spends an action to douse it.

name: Nullsteel Longsword
description: A +2 longsword of dead grey metal. A creature hit by it cannot regain hit points until the end of its next turn, and magical healing used on it during that time is wasted.

name: Stormpetrel Spear
description: A +2 spear that returns to your hand immediately after being thrown. Once per short rest, it trails lightning on the throw, dealing an extra 3d6 lightning damage.

name: Harrier's Pair
description: Two +2 daggers that function as one item. When you hit the same creature with both in a turn, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

name: The Long Memory
description: A +2 longsword that records every creature it has wounded. Against a creature it has wounded before, it deals an extra 2d8 damage and you have advantage on the attack.

name: Hollowing Greatsword
description: A +2 greatsword. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt, lasting until your next long rest.

name: Frostlock Halberd
description: A +2 halberd. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn as ice crusts its legs.

name: Sunderer's Edge
description: A +2 battleaxe. On a critical hit against a creature wearing armour or carrying a shield, that item's AC contribution is reduced by 1 until repaired over a long rest.

name: The Quiet Argument
description: A +2 rapier. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by it makes no sound and leaves no blood, and remains standing for one round before falling.

name: Hivebrand Flail
description: A +2 flail whose head splits into three on command. Once per short rest, make one attack roll against each of up to three creatures within reach, dealing 2d6 piercing damage on a hit.

name: Lodestone Gauntlets
description: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d8 force damage and count as magical. As a bonus action you may pull a metal object weighing 20 pounds or less within 30 feet into your hand.

name: Widowmaker Crossbow
description: A +2 heavy crossbow. Against a creature at or below half its hit point maximum, it scores a critical hit on a roll of 18 to 20.

name: Eyeless Blade
description: A +2 shortsword. While Blinded or in darkness you suffer no penalty to attack rolls with it, and you know the location of any creature within 15 feet that you can hear.

name: The Tollgate
description: A +2 polearm with reach. When a creature enters your reach for the first time on its turn, you may use your reaction to make an attack against it; on a hit its movement ends.

name: Scattercase Darts
description: A case of 12 +2 darts. Once per short rest, throw the whole case: each creature in a 15-foot cone takes 4d4 piercing damage, DC 15 Dexterity save for half. The case refills at dawn.

name: Molten Chain
description: A +2 flail of white-hot links. It deals an extra 1d8 fire damage, sheds bright light in 20 feet, and ignites flammable objects it strikes.

name: Peacebond Sabre
description: A +2 scimitar. Once per day, on a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be unable to make attacks against anyone but you until the end of its next turn.

name: Bonewhite Pike
description: A +2 pike. Against creatures of Large size or larger it deals an extra 2d8 piercing damage, and you have advantage on saves against being knocked Prone while wielding it.

name: Second Thought
description: A +2 dagger. Once per short rest, when you miss with an attack using it, you may reroll the attack roll and must use the new result.

name: Gravewarden Mace
description: A +2 mace. It deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage to Undead, and an Undead of CR 1 or lower reduced to 0 hit points by it is destroyed utterly and cannot be raised again.

name: The Unfinished Sentence
description: A +2 shortsword. When you hit a creature that is Concentrating, it has disadvantage on the saving throw to maintain concentration.

name: Eclipseblade
description: A +2 shortsword that alternates between radiant and necrotic — choose the damage type each time you attack. Once per day on a critical hit, an Eclipse Burst erupts from the target: a 15-foot sphere of blinding shadow-light (DC 16 Constitution save or Blinded until end of your next turn). Forged at the moment of the last recorded solar eclipse.

name: Sunbreaker Warhammer
description: A +2 warhammer that deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage on a hit. When you hit a creature that is concentrating on a spell, it automatically fails its Concentration saving throw. Forged by a DOL artificer who later defected — and was never found.

name: Nightclaw Daggers
description: A matched pair of +2 daggers (attuned together). While holding both, your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. On your turn, if you attack with both, the second attack deals an extra 2d6 necrotic damage. The blades are cold to the touch even in summer.

name: Luminary's Wrath
description: A +3 longsword dealing an extra 2d8 radiant damage against creatures in darkness or shadow. Once per day, speak its command word to cast Sunbeam without concentration for 1 minute. Wielding it in defiance of the DOL is considered high treason.

name: Dawnmarch Greatsword
description: A +3 greatsword that burns with pale gold fire. It deals an extra 2d8 radiant damage, and once per day you may release a 30-foot cone of light dealing 6d8 radiant damage, DC 17 Dexterity save for half.

name: The Severance
description: A +3 scimitar honed to an impossible edge. On a critical hit against a creature of Large size or smaller, it severs a limb or appendage at the DM's discretion, dealing an extra 4d8 slashing damage.

name: Tempest Maul
description: A +3 maul with 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. On a hit you may expend a charge to call down lightning: the target and all creatures within 10 feet take 5d10 lightning damage, DC 17 Dexterity save for half.

name: Oblivion's Needle
description: A +3 dagger of absolute black. A creature it reduces to 0 hit points is disintegrated along with everything it carries, leaving only fine grey dust.

name: Hornfall Longbow
description: A +3 longbow. You may fire three arrows as a single Attack action, each making its own attack roll. Once per day, an arrow you fire splits into a volley striking every hostile creature in a 30-foot line.

name: The Undertow
description: A +3 trident. On a hit the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength save or be pulled 15 feet toward you and knocked Prone. Underwater it deals an extra 3d6 cold damage.

name: Mirrorfall Rapier
description: A +3 rapier with a reflective blade. Once per day, when a creature within 5 feet casts a spell targeting only you, you may use your reaction to reflect it back at the caster.

name: Cinderking's Axe
description: A +3 greataxe wreathed in embers. It deals an extra 3d6 fire damage, and a creature reduced to 0 hit points by it burns to ash in one round, leaving nothing behind.

name: The Long Silence
description: A +3 longsword. A creature hit by it cannot cast spells with verbal components until the end of its next turn, and has disadvantage on Charisma checks for one minute.

name: Boneshiver Flail
description: A +3 flail. On a critical hit the target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution save or have its hit point maximum reduced by 2d10 until it finishes a long rest.

name: Glasswind Spear
description: A +3 spear that returns when thrown. Once per short rest, you may throw it at a point within 120 feet; it strikes every creature in a line to that point for 4d8 piercing damage, DC 17 Dexterity save for half.

name: The Auditor
description: A +3 warhammer. Against a creature that has told a deliberate lie in your hearing within the last hour, it deals an extra 4d8 force damage and the wielder knows the lie's subject.

name: Frosthollow Halberd
description: A +3 halberd. Creatures that start their turn within 10 feet of you take 1d6 cold damage, and difficult terrain of ice forms in your wake as you move.

name: Nightpiercer
description: A +3 heavy crossbow. Its bolts pass through nonmagical cover and barriers up to one foot thick as though they were not there.

name: The Weight of Office
description: A +3 mace. While you hold it, hostile creatures within 30 feet that can see you have disadvantage on the first attack roll they make each turn against anyone other than you.

name: Ravenscall Sickle
description: A +3 sickle. Each creature it reduces to 0 hit points summons a spectral raven that fights for you for one minute, with 15 temporary hit points. Maximum three at once.

name: Shearwater Cutlass
description: A +3 scimitar. Once per short rest, you may move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks, making one attack with this weapon against each creature you pass.

name: The Standing Debt
description: A +3 dagger. When a creature damages you, you may use your reaction to mark it. Your next attack against a marked creature deals an extra 5d6 piercing damage. One mark at a time.

name: Starfall Javelins
description: A set of three +3 javelins that return at dawn. A javelin thrown at a point within 120 feet detonates for 6d6 radiant damage in a 10-foot radius, DC 17 Dexterity save for half.

name: The Hunger — Ashbone Greataxe
description: A +3 greataxe of ash-grey bone that grows stronger with each kill. Each time it reduces a creature to 0 hit points, gain a cumulative +1 to attack and damage rolls (max +5, resets at dawn). At +5, it deals an extra 3d12 necrotic damage and the wielder cannot be Charmed or Frightened. The axe whispers names — of the dead, and eventually of the living.

name: Solbreaker — Blade of the Fallen Sun
description: A +3 greatsword dealing an extra 3d6 radiant damage. Once per day as an action, unleash the Fallen Sun: a 60-foot cone of solar energy deals 10d10 radiant damage (DC 18 Dexterity save, half on success) and permanently dispels any magical darkness it touches. The DOL has a standing order to retrieve this blade at any cost.

name: Worldsplitter
description: A +3 greataxe taller than most men. Once per day, on a critical hit, it cleaves a 20-foot line of ground into a chasm 10 feet deep; creatures in the line take 8d12 slashing damage and fall in, DC 20 Dexterity save for half and no fall.

name: The Last Word
description: A +3 rapier. Once per day, when you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you may immediately take another full turn. Drawn in silence, the blade whispers the name of everyone it has killed.

name: Heartstop
description: A +3 dagger of black glass. Once per day, on a hit against a creature with 100 hit points or fewer, the target must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution save or drop to 0 hit points immediately.

name: The Siege Engine
description: A +3 maul weighing 200 pounds that only its attuned wielder can lift. It deals an extra 4d10 bludgeoning damage to objects and structures, and on a hit a creature must succeed on a DC 20 Strength save or be hurled 30 feet.

name: Sunsetter
description: A +3 longbow. Once per day, you may loose an arrow that blots out light in a one-mile radius for one minute; during that time your attacks with this bow score critical hits on a roll of 18 to 20.

name: The Covenant Blade
description: A +3 longsword. Name one creature at dawn. Against that creature the blade deals an extra 6d8 damage and ignores all resistances and immunities; against everything else it is merely a +1 weapon that day.

name: Ruin, the Patient Spear
description: A +3 spear that returns when thrown. Every hit against the same creature in a single combat increases its damage by 1d8, cumulative, resetting when combat ends. There is no maximum.

name: The Shearing Tide
description: A +3 trident. As an action, summon a wave in a 60-foot line: 10d6 bludgeoning damage, DC 20 Strength save for half and not swept 30 feet away. Recharges at dawn. Underwater, the wielder's speed triples.

name: Gravemaker's Scythe
description: A +3 glaive. Creatures reduced to 0 hit points by it rise at the start of your next turn as Zombies under your control, lasting one hour. Maximum five at once.

name: The Immaculate Edge
description: A +3 shortsword that has never been blunted or stained. It ignores all damage resistance and immunity, scores critical hits on 19 or 20, and cannot be destroyed by any means.

name: Thunderthrone Hammer
description: A +3 warhammer with 12 charges, regaining 1d8+2 at dawn. Spend 3 charges to cast Call Lightning, 6 for Chain Lightning, or 1 to add 2d10 lightning damage to a hit. While holding it you have resistance to lightning damage.

name: The Final Tally
description: A +3 flail that counts every creature it has slain. Once per day you may invoke the count: the weapon deals extra necrotic damage equal to the number of kills recorded, to a maximum of 50.

name: Solar Plate
description: Polished plate armour etched with the Division of Lumination's sigil. While wearing it, you have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks against civilians. The gleam is impossible to miss, which is entirely the point.

name: Pilgrim's Vest
description: A sturdy leather doublet (AC 11 + Dex) stitched with small warding tokens. You have advantage on saving throws against the Frightened condition. Worn by travellers crossing the outer reaches where the DOL's reach grows thin.

name: Driftweave Cloak
description: A light travelling cloak that grants +1 to AC while worn over non-heavy armour. It billows dramatically regardless of wind direction, which is either unsettling or impressive depending on context.

name: Quilted Jack of the Road
description: Padded armour stitched with travellers' charms. You suffer no exhaustion from a forced march of up to 10 hours, and the padding never grows damp.

name: Tarsealed Leathers
description: Leather armour treated with black tar. It is immune to acid damage and grants advantage on saves against being set alight.

name: Cobbler's Boots of Even Tread
description: You have advantage on saves against being knocked Prone by uneven ground, ice or shifting footing, and you never slip on wet stone.

name: Gravedigger's Apron
description: Heavy oiled canvas worn over armour. You have advantage on saves against disease, and the smell of decay does not sicken you.

name: Woolwrap of the Northern Pass
description: A thick layered cloak. You are comfortable in temperatures as low as -20 degrees and have advantage on saves against extreme cold.

name: Scaled Vest of Small Mercies
description: Light scale worn beneath clothing. Once per day, when you would take 5 or less damage from a single attack, you take none instead.

name: Tanner's Bracers
description: Stiff leather vambraces. You have advantage on saves against being disarmed, and on Strength checks made to hold onto a rope or ledge.

name: Hodman's Shoulderguard
description: A single reinforced pauldron. You can carry twice the normal weight without becoming Encumbered.

name: Shield of the Standing Order
description: A plain shield bearing a worn crest. While you take the Dodge action, allies within 5 feet of you gain a +1 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Brine-Cured Hide
description: Hide armour hardened in seawater. It never rots or moulders, and you can swim at your normal speed while wearing it.

name: Rushlight Helm
description: A helm with a small caged flame at the brow. It sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius, can be covered as a bonus action, and burns without fuel.

name: Pilgrim's Sandals
description: Your feet never blister, you leave no footprints on consecrated ground, and your walking speed increases by 5 feet on a road or marked path.

name: Wicker Shield of the Marsh
description: A woven shield that floats and supports up to 300 pounds in water. It provides its AC bonus normally but is destroyed by fire damage.

name: Mail of Small Repairs
description: Chain shirt whose links knit themselves back together. Any damage to the armour itself mends fully over an hour, and it never needs oiling.

name: Nightporter's Gloves
description: Soft dark gloves. You have advantage on Dexterity checks made to handle objects quietly, and you never drop an item from numb or cold hands.

name: Carter's Greaves
description: Battered shin plates. You take no damage from falls of 10 feet or less and ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble.

name: Choirboy's Surplice
description: A white overgarment. While you wear it and take no hostile action, creatures have disadvantage on checks to identify you as a threat.

name: Splintmail of the Levy
description: Issued splint armour. While within 10 feet of an ally also wearing armour, you gain a +1 bonus to saves against being Frightened.

name: Hornbeam Buckler
description: A small wooden shield. Once per short rest, when hit by a melee attack, you may add 2 to your AC against that attack.

name: Mudlark's Waders
description: Thigh-high boots. You ignore difficult terrain caused by mud, silt or shallow water, and your feet remain dry.

name: Ratcatcher's Coat
description: A long coat of layered hide. You have resistance to damage from Swarms of Small beasts, and vermin will not willingly approach you.

name: Glazier's Visor
description: A smoked glass visor. You are immune to being Blinded by sudden bright light, and have advantage on saves against gaze attacks.

name: Stonecutter's Mitts
description: Thick leather gauntlets. You can handle hot or jagged objects without harm, and have advantage on checks to climb rough stone.

name: Bannerbearer's Harness
description: A chest harness with a socket for a standard. You can plant or draw a banner as a bonus action, and cannot be shoved while it is planted.

name: Felted Underpadding
description: Worn beneath any armour. You reduce bludgeoning damage from falls and nonmagical weapons by 1, to a minimum of 1.

name: Verger's Mantle
description: A modest shoulder cloak. Once per day you may reroll a failed saving throw against being Charmed.

name: Hobnailed Marching Boots
description: Your speed is unaffected by heavy armour, and you can march for 12 hours before risking exhaustion instead of 8.

name: Fishscale Jerkin
description: Studded leather set with overlapping scales. You can hold your breath for twice as long and have advantage on checks to escape a grapple while wet.

name: Tollman's Gorget
description: A throat guard of banded steel. You have advantage on saves against effects that would Deafen, Silence or choke you.

name: Scullion's Smock
description: A stained working garment. It cleans itself at dawn, resists stains and burns, and grants advantage on checks to pass unnoticed among servants.

name: Coracle Shield
description: A round hide shield that doubles as a one-person boat. Unfolding or stowing it takes one minute.

name: Lamplit Cuirass
description: A breastplate with a glass panel at the heart. It glows faintly when undead are within 30 feet, growing brighter the closer they are.

name: Gaoler's Keyed Belt
description: A heavy belt hung with rings. Items fastened to it cannot be removed by anyone but you, and it holds up to 20 pounds without weighing you down.

name: Threadbare Travelling Cloak
description: Much-mended but warm. It keeps off rain entirely, and once per day you may use it to grant a creature you cover advantage on one save against cold.

name: Ironveil Mail
description: Chainmail (AC 16) woven with fine shadow-treated wire. While wearing it, ranged attacks against you have disadvantage if you are in dim light or darkness. The weave was a Shadowsong innovation, banned under the Luminary Edicts.

name: Warden's Half-Plate
description: Half-plate (AC 15 + Dex max 2) fitted with vambraces that can absorb one weapon attack per short rest, reducing its damage by 1d8. DOL wardens were issued this armour during the Pacification Campaigns, and old examples still bear their unit sigils.

name: Thornweave Leathers
description: Studded leather (AC 12 + Dex) grown from a plant found only in the Outer Reaches. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes 2 piercing damage. The armour regrows its thorns after each long rest.

name: Ironveil Half-Helm
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC against attacks that would score a critical hit, turning such a hit into a normal hit once per short rest.

name: Driftmail
description: +1 chain shirt. You have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed and can breathe underwater for up to one hour per day.

name: Bramblehide Armour
description: +1 hide armour covered in thorns. A creature that grapples you or hits you with an unarmed strike takes 1d4 piercing damage.

name: Shield of Turned Arrows
description: +1 shield. Once per short rest, when a ranged weapon attack hits you, you may use your reaction to deflect it, taking no damage.

name: Ashglass Breastplate
description: +1 breastplate. You have resistance to fire damage for one minute after taking fire damage, once per short rest.

name: Boots of the Sure Ascent
description: You gain a climbing speed equal to half your walking speed, and you cannot be knocked Prone while climbing.

name: Mirrorplate Pauldrons
description: Polished shoulder plates. Once per day, when a creature makes a ranged spell attack against you and misses, the attacker takes damage equal to half what it would have dealt.

name: Cloak of the Lesser Shade
description: While in dim light or darkness you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and your silhouette is hard to fix.

name: Warden's Scale
description: +1 scale mail. You do not suffer disadvantage on Stealth checks while wearing it.

name: Gauntlets of the Locked Grip
description: You cannot be disarmed, you have advantage on checks to maintain a grapple, and you can hang from one hand indefinitely.

name: Nullweave Robes
description: AC 12 + Dexterity modifier. Once per short rest, you may gain advantage on a saving throw against a spell of 2nd level or lower.

name: Shield of the Barred Door
description: +1 shield. As an action you may plant it to create a wall of force 5 feet wide and 5 feet tall lasting one minute. It has AC 18 and 25 hit points.

name: Thorncrown Helm
description: You have advantage on saves against being Charmed, and a creature that attempts to read your thoughts takes 1d6 psychic damage.

name: Fenstalker's Greaves
description: You ignore all difficult terrain caused by water, mud, undergrowth or snow, and leave no tracks in soft ground.

name: Carapace Jack
description: +1 studded leather of chitin plates. You have advantage on saves against poison and resistance to poison damage for one hour after being Poisoned.

name: Standard-Bearer's Plate
description: +1 half plate. Allies within 15 feet who can see you have advantage on their first saving throw against being Frightened each combat.

name: Hoarfrost Mail
description: +1 chain mail. Creatures that hit you with a melee attack take 1d4 cold damage, and you are immune to the effects of extreme cold.

name: Veilcloth Hood
description: While the hood is up, magical attempts to scry on or locate you have disadvantage, and your face cannot be recalled clearly by those who see it.

name: Shield of the Steady Line
description: +1 shield. While you are adjacent to at least one ally, you and that ally cannot be moved against your will by a Shove or similar effect.

name: Riverglass Brigandine
description: +1 studded leather. Once per short rest, when you take damage from a melee attack, you may become translucent until the start of your next turn, gaining advantage on Stealth.

name: Deadweight Boots
description: As a bonus action you may increase your weight tenfold, becoming immovable by any force short of a Giant. Your speed drops to 0 while active.

name: Scorchplate Bracers
description: Once per short rest, when you take fire damage, you may use your reaction to absorb it: you take half, and your next melee attack deals an extra 1d6 fire damage.

name: Hushstep Slippers
description: Your footsteps make no sound of any kind, on any surface. You still trigger pressure plates and other physical traps.

name: Oathplate Gorget
description: While you have taken no hostile action this combat, you gain a +2 bonus to AC. The bonus is lost the moment you attack.

name: Shieldmate's Targe
description: +1 shield. As a reaction, you may grant its AC bonus to an ally within 5 feet against one attack instead of yourself.

name: Beggar's Ragged Mantle
description: AC 11 + Dexterity modifier. While worn, you appear destitute to all who see you, and creatures have disadvantage on checks to determine your true wealth or station.

name: Stormlashed Cuirass
description: +1 breastplate. You have resistance to lightning damage, and you are unaffected by strong winds or driving rain.

name: Gravemantle
description: Undead of CR 1 or lower will not attack you unless you attack first. You have advantage on saves against effects that would reduce your hit point maximum.

name: Sandrunner's Wraps
description: You are immune to the effects of extreme heat, need only half the normal water, and ignore difficult terrain caused by sand or scree.

name: Nightbloom Plate
description: +1 plate armour that is utterly silent. You do not suffer disadvantage on Stealth checks while wearing it, and it weighs half as much as normal plate.

name: Mantle of Hollow Bones
description: Your weight is reduced by three quarters. You take half damage from falls and can walk across surfaces that would not bear a child.

name: Coldmist Breastplate
description: A +1 breastplate (AC 14 + Dex max 2) that exudes a faint cold mist, granting resistance to fire damage. Once per day as a reaction, you can exhale stored cold in a 15-foot cone dealing 4d6 cold damage (DC 14 Constitution save, half on success).

name: Carapace of the Buried
description: A +1 suit of scale mail made from the shells of something that lived underground for a very long time. You have tremorsense out to 30 feet and cannot be knocked Prone while wearing it. It smells faintly of deep earth no matter how often it is cleaned.

name: Resonance Plate
description: A +1 full plate (AC 18) studded with Echo Vein crystals. When a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, the crystals emit a pulse — the attacker takes 2d6 thunder damage and must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet back.

name: Nullplate
description: A +1 half-plate of dull grey metal that absorbs magical energy, granting advantage on saving throws against spells. Once per day when targeted by a spell of 3rd level or lower, you can use your reaction to negate the spell entirely.

name: Resonance Half-Plate
description: +2 half plate. When you take thunder or force damage, you absorb some of it: your next melee attack before the end of your next turn deals an extra 2d6 thunder damage.

name: Plate of the Closed Book
description: +2 plate armour. You have advantage on saves against divination magic, and spells cast to read your mind or detect your alignment simply fail.

name: Shield of the Last Stand
description: +2 shield. While you are below half your hit point maximum, you gain an additional +2 to AC and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

name: Wyrmscale Hauberk
description: +1 scale mail. Choose a damage type from acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison when you attune; you gain resistance to it. You may change the choice on a long rest.

name: Cloak of the Second Shadow
description: Once per short rest, as a bonus action, create an illusory duplicate of yourself that lasts one minute. Attacks have a 50 percent chance of targeting the duplicate instead of you.

name: Bulwark Greaves
description: Your speed cannot be reduced, you are immune to being knocked Prone, and you have advantage on all saves against forced movement.

name: Carapace of the Deep Shelf
description: +2 breastplate. You can breathe underwater, have a swimming speed of 40 feet, and are immune to damage from water pressure at any depth.

name: Helm of the Open Field
description: You cannot be surprised, you have advantage on initiative rolls, and you are aware of any hostile creature within 60 feet even if you cannot see it.

name: Scorchmantle
description: You have immunity to fire damage from nonmagical sources and resistance to magical fire. Once per day, when you take fire damage, you may release it as a 15-foot cone dealing 4d6 fire damage.

name: Plate of Unbroken Vigil
description: +2 plate armour. You do not suffer exhaustion from lack of sleep, and while you are Concentrating you have advantage on Constitution saves to maintain it.

name: Shield of the Returning Blow
description: +2 shield. When a creature within 5 feet misses you with a melee attack, you may use your reaction to deal 2d6 force damage to it. Three times per day.

name: Nullthread Robes
description: AC 13 + Dexterity modifier. You have advantage on saving throws against spells, and a spell of 3rd level or lower that targets only you fails once per day.

name: Gauntlets of the Iron Promise
description: Your Strength score becomes 19 if it is not already higher. You can lift, drag and carry as though you were one size larger.

name: Mantle of the Interrogator
description: You have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Once per day you may force a creature within 30 feet to make a DC 15 Wisdom save or answer one question truthfully.

name: Ghostweave Brigandine
description: +2 studded leather. Once per day, as an action, you become incorporeal for one minute, able to move through solid objects but unable to attack or be attacked.

name: Shield of Ten Thousand Dents
description: +1 shield that records every blow it has taken. As a reaction, you may reduce incoming damage by 3d6; each use adds a dent, and after five uses in a day it ceases to function until dawn.

name: Plate of the Cold Furnace
description: +2 plate armour. You are immune to extreme cold and to cold damage from nonmagical sources, and creatures that end their turn within 5 feet take 1d6 cold damage.

name: Boots of the Borrowed Mile
description: Your walking speed increases by 15 feet. Three times per day you may take the Dash action as a bonus action.

name: Hauberk of Divided Harm
description: +2 chain mail. When you take damage, you may use your reaction to transfer half of it to a willing creature within 30 feet.

name: Visor of the Written World
description: You can read any written language, see invisible creatures within 30 feet, and are immune to illusions of the first and second level.

name: Scalemail of the Patient Serpent
description: +2 scale mail. You have advantage on saves against poison, immunity to the Poisoned condition, and your unarmed strikes deal an extra 1d4 poison damage.

name: Shroud of Quiet Passage
description: Once per short rest, you may become invisible as a bonus action until you attack, cast a spell or until one minute passes.

name: Bracers of the Turned Spell
description: Three charges, regained at dawn. As a reaction to being targeted by a spell of 3rd level or lower, spend a charge to impose disadvantage on the attack or gain advantage on the save.

name: Plate of the Standing Wall
description: +2 plate armour. Allies within 5 feet of you gain half cover. You cannot be moved from your space by any effect that does not deal damage.

name: Cowl of the Silent Choir
description: You are immune to thunder damage and the Deafened condition. Once per day you may create a 20-foot sphere of absolute silence centred on yourself for one minute.

name: Harness of the Falling Star
description: You take no falling damage from any height and may descend at 60 feet per round as though slowed. On landing from a fall of 20 feet or more you may deal 3d6 bludgeoning damage in a 10-foot radius.

name: Greatshield of the Held Line
description: +2 shield that may be planted as an action, becoming total cover for you and one adjacent ally until you move. While planted you cannot take the Dash or Disengage action.

name: Mirrorshell Armour
description: A +2 breastplate whose surface is perfectly reflective. Once per day, when a spell that requires an attack roll hits you, you can use your reaction to reflect it back at the caster using their own spell attack bonus and save DC.

name: Voidweave Robes
description: These robes grant AC 13 + Dex modifier (no armour proficiency required) and resistance to necrotic and psychic damage. While wearing them, you can cast Blink once per day without expending a spell slot. The fabric seems to absorb light rather than reflect it.

name: Plate of the Undying Sentinel
description: A +2 full plate (AC 18). While wearing it, when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you instead drop to 1 hit point — usable once per dawn. Legends say it was worn by a DOL general who refused to die until the war was over, and then refused to die after.

name: Aegis of the Unbroken Oath
description: +3 shield. Once per day, when you or an ally within 10 feet would be reduced to 0 hit points, that creature instead drops to 1 hit point.

name: Plate of the Sunlit Hall
description: +3 plate armour that sheds bright light in 30 feet at will. Undead and Fiends within that light have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

name: Voidmantle
description: AC 15 + Dexterity modifier. Once per day you may step into shadow and reappear in any shadow you can see within 300 feet.

name: Hauberk of the Still Heart
description: +3 chain mail. You are immune to the Frightened and Charmed conditions, and critical hits against you become normal hits.

name: Carapace of Returning Spite
description: +3 half plate. A creature that hits you with a melee attack takes damage equal to half the damage it dealt, as force.

name: Boots of the Unwalked Path
description: You gain a flying speed of 30 feet and may hover. Three times per day you may cast Misty Step without expending a spell slot.

name: Plate of the Hollow King
description: +3 plate armour. While wearing it you do not need to eat, drink, breathe or sleep, and you are immune to necrotic damage and to having your hit point maximum reduced.

name: Shroud of the Unseen Hour
description: Once per day, as an action, you become invisible, inaudible and undetectable by divination for ten minutes. Attacking ends the effect.

name: Greaves of the Immovable
description: You cannot be moved, teleported or banished against your will. You may walk on water, lava and thin air as though it were solid ground for one minute per day.

name: Mirrorshell Cuirass
description: +3 breastplate. Once per day, when a spell targets only you, you may reflect it back at the caster with its original save DC.

name: Helm of Three Watches
description: You have truesight to 60 feet, cannot be Blinded or Surprised, and you are aware of the location of every creature within 120 feet that has line of effect to you.

name: Scale of the Drowned God
description: +3 scale mail. You can breathe water, have a swimming speed of 60 feet, and as an action may summon a wave dealing 6d8 bludgeoning damage in a 30-foot line, DC 17 Strength save for half.

name: Bracers of the Final Ward
description: You gain a +2 bonus to AC and to all saving throws. Once per day, when you fail a saving throw, you may choose to succeed instead.

name: Plate of the Burning Vigil
description: +3 plate armour wreathed in white flame. Creatures that start their turn within 10 feet take 2d6 fire damage. You are immune to fire.

name: Shield of the Severed Line
description: +3 shield. As a reaction to any spell targeting you or an ally within 10 feet, you may attempt to counter it as though casting Counterspell at 5th level. Twice per day.

name: Mantle of the Thousand Faces
description: At will, you may alter your appearance, voice and apparent size by one category. The disguise withstands all but truesight and cannot be detected by Investigation.

name: Harness of the Returning Blade
description: +3 studded leather. When a creature within 30 feet makes a ranged weapon attack against you and misses, the ammunition reverses and strikes the attacker for its normal damage.

name: Cuirass of the Divided Wound
description: +3 breastplate. All damage you take is halved; the other half is dealt to a creature of your choice that you have damaged within the last minute.

name: Greatplate of the Last Watchman
description: +3 plate armour. While you remain within 10 feet of an unconscious or dying ally, you cannot be reduced below 1 hit point and your attacks score critical hits on 19 or 20.

name: Eclipse Carapace
description: A +3 suit of full plate (AC 18) forged during the last eclipse in living memory, granting immunity to radiant and necrotic damage. Once per day as a bonus action, you become incorporeal until the start of your next turn — moving through solid matter and immune to all physical damage for that duration. The armour makes no sound, no matter how hard you strike it.

name: The Unbreaking
description: +3 plate armour that cannot be damaged, sundered or removed against your will. You are immune to critical hits, cannot be Stunned or Paralysed, and you automatically succeed on Strength and Constitution saving throws.

name: Aegis of the Shut Gate
description: +3 shield. As an action, raise it to create an impassable wall of force 20 feet wide and 20 feet tall for one minute. Nothing short of a Wish passes through it. Recharges at dawn.

name: Mantle of the Nine Deaths
description: Nine threads hang from the hem. When you would be reduced to 0 hit points, one thread burns away and you instead drop to half your hit point maximum. When the last thread burns, the mantle becomes ordinary cloth.

name: Skin of the Patient Mountain
description: +3 plate armour. You have resistance to all damage. Once per day, as a reaction, you may become immune to all damage until the start of your next turn.

name: The Quiet Coat
description: AC 16 + Dexterity modifier. You are permanently invisible to all creatures that have not yet seen you this day, and divination magic cannot locate you by any means.

name: Carapace of the Unmade
description: +3 half plate. Any creature that damages you must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution save or take necrotic damage equal to the damage it dealt.

name: Crown-Helm of the Standing Realm
description: You gain truesight to 120 feet, immunity to all mind-affecting magic, and allies within 30 feet who can see you gain a +2 bonus to all saving throws.

name: Boots of the World's Edge
description: You gain a flying speed of 60 feet with hover. Once per day you may cast Plane Shift, affecting only yourself, without a spell slot or component.

name: The Shriven Plate
description: +3 plate armour. You are immune to necrotic and poison damage, cannot be Diseased or Poisoned, do not age, and cannot be raised as undead.

name: Shield of the Last Argument
description: +3 shield. Three times per day, as a reaction, you may negate all damage and effects from a single attack or spell, no matter its source or power.

name: Veil of the Absent Self
description: AC 15 + Dexterity modifier. Once per day you may remove yourself from existence for up to one minute: you cannot act, be targeted, perceived or affected, and return in the same space.

name: The Warden's Own
description: +3 plate armour. You may use your reaction to take all damage dealt to any ally within 30 feet in their stead, and you have resistance to all damage taken this way.

name: Glowstone Amulet
description: A smooth stone worn on a cord that glows faintly when undead are within 30 feet, intensifying the closer they are. Merchants in the outer reaches sell these cheaply; outside the city walls, they sell out quickly.

name: Wayfinder's Compass
description: This brass compass always points toward the last place you called home. You can change the target during a long rest by holding it and concentrating on a specific location. If you have no home, the needle spins slowly.

name: Veil-Touched Coin
description: A silver coin stamped with both a sun and a crescent moon — illegal tender under DOL law. Flip it and call the result: if correct, gain advantage on your next ability check; if wrong, take disadvantage. The coin never cheats; neither does luck.

name: Resonance Shard
description: A thumb-sized Echo Vein crystal that vibrates when speech directed at the holder carries intent to deceive. It doesn't identify the lie — it just hums. Investigators prize these; accused individuals learn to speak carefully.

name: Lantern of Still Flame
description: This lantern's flame cannot be extinguished by wind or water and requires no oil, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for another 20 feet. Once per day as a bonus action, you can cause it to go completely dark for 10 minutes — the flame remembers exactly where it was.

name: Tally Stones
description: A pouch of twelve smooth pebbles. Each counts one thing you name aloud when you set it down, and reports the total when you pick it up, no matter how much time has passed.

name: Everdamp Sponge
description: Holds one gallon of clean water indefinitely and refills itself at dawn. Squeezing it produces water at the temperature it was collected.

name: Cartographer's Thumb
description: A brass thimble. While worn, you always know which direction is north and how far you have travelled since dawn, to the nearest hundred feet.

name: Mourner's Bell-Pin
description: A small silver pin. It chimes once, softly, whenever a creature dies within 60 feet of you, even if you cannot see it.

name: Pocket of Borrowed Warmth
description: A sewn-in pocket that can be attached to any garment. Anything placed inside stays at a comfortable warmth, and your hands never go numb.

name: Ink That Will Not Lie
description: A bottle holding enough for fifty pages. Any deliberate falsehood written with it fades within the hour; truths remain and cannot be erased.

name: Lodestone Compass of the Lost
description: Points not north but toward the nearest road, path or inhabited dwelling within five miles. If none exists, the needle spins slowly.

name: Ration Tin of Small Comfort
description: A dented tin that produces one plain but hot meal each dawn. The food is never good and never spoils.

name: Whistle for the Absent Dog
description: Silent to all but canines. Any dog or wolf within a half mile hears it and knows your rough location, though it is under no obligation to come.

name: Patchcloth
description: A square of grey fabric that mends any single tear, hole or break in cloth, leather or paper when laid over it for one minute, then crumbles.

name: Candle of the Fourth Watch
description: Burns for exactly four hours and cannot be extinguished by wind or water. It gutters violently one minute before a hostile creature comes within 100 feet.

name: Thief's Honest Mirror
description: A hand mirror that shows objects as they truly are, stripping away paint, polish and cosmetic illusion. It cannot see through magical disguise.

name: Knot of the Bound Promise
description: A length of red cord. Tied between two willing people, it tightens faintly when either speaks the other's name, however far apart they are.

name: Scrivener's Second Hand
description: A quill that copies, in your own handwriting, whatever you read aloud to it, onto any paper beneath. It writes at the speed of speech.

name: Jar of Kept Weather
description: Open the jar to release the weather sealed inside it, filling a 20-foot radius for one minute. It can be refilled by leaving it open through a storm.

name: Bootblack of the Unmarked Step
description: A tin of black wax. Boots treated with it leave no prints on any surface for 24 hours.

name: Coinpurse of the Small Sum
description: Each dawn it contains 1d6 copper pieces that were not there before. Nobody has ever worked out where they come from.

name: Signal Kerchief
description: A square of cloth that changes to any colour you name as a bonus action. Its colour is visible at twice the normal distance in daylight.

name: Nightjar's Earcup
description: A brass cup held to the ear. You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing, but disadvantage on saves against thunder damage while using it.

name: Fisherman's Patient Float
description: A cork bob that fishes on its own. Left in water for an hour, it catches 1d4 edible fish without supervision.

name: Lock of the Small Hours
description: A padlock that cannot be picked between midnight and dawn. At all other hours it is an ordinary lock.

name: Chalk of the Remembered Wall
description: A stick of white chalk. Marks made with it are invisible to everyone but you and those you named when drawing, and last one month.

name: Stirrup of the Steady Seat
description: Fitted to any saddle. You cannot be knocked from your mount against your will, and you have advantage on checks to stay mounted.

name: Seed of One Day's Shade
description: Planted and watered, it grows into a broad tree in one minute, lasting 24 hours before withering. It provides shade and cover for six people.

name: Fiddler's Rosin of Small Luck
description: Once per day, applied to any stringed instrument, it grants advantage on one Charisma (Performance) check made within the hour.

name: Bottle of the Last Smell
description: Uncork it to release the scent of the last place it was opened. Useful for tracking dogs, sentiment, and little else.

name: Needle That Finds the Seam
description: A sewing needle that leaps gently in your hand when held within 10 feet of a hidden door, false bottom or concealed compartment.

name: Tinderbox of the Certain Spark
description: Lights any flammable material on the first strike, regardless of wind, rain or dampness. It never runs out of flint.

name: Gravecloth Handkerchief
description: Laid over a corpse's face, it shows the last thing the creature saw as a still image for one minute. It works only once per corpse.

name: Wayfarer's Folding Stool
description: Folds to the size of a book and weighs a pound. Sitting on it for ten minutes removes the fatigue of one hour's marching.

name: Glass of the Honest Measure
description: A drinking glass that cannot be filled with poison, spoiled drink or anything harmful. Such liquids simply pour straight through it.

name: Bellows of the Banked Fire
description: Keeps any fire it has fanned burning for eight hours without fuel or attention. It works on one fire at a time.

name: Button of the Returned Coat
description: Sewn onto a garment, the garment finds its way back to you within one day of being lost or stolen, by whatever means circumstance allows.

name: Spectacles of the Faded Page
description: Through these, worn, burned or water-damaged writing appears as it did when first written, so long as any trace of the original remains.

name: Hourglass of the Honest Hour
description: Runs for exactly one hour and cannot be tampered with, hurried or stopped. It rings a single clear note when it empties.

name: Hollow Locket
description: A brass locket that, when closed over a whispered message, preserves it until opened by the person whose name you spoke. The message plays back once in the speaker's voice, then is gone. Used by Shadowsong sympathisers to leave instructions without written evidence.

name: Boots of the Prowling Dark
description: These soft leather boots muffle your footsteps entirely — you cannot be heard moving while wearing them. Additionally, difficult terrain caused by darkness or shadow costs you no extra movement. They are always slightly warm to the touch.

name: Mask of Borrowed Faces
description: A plain white mask that lets you cast Disguise Self at will. Once per day, if you have seen a specific humanoid in the past 24 hours, the disguise can perfectly replicate their appearance. The mask feels uncomfortably warm when copying someone who is still alive.

name: Echo Vein Focus
description: A faceted Echo Vein crystal on a chain used as a spellcasting focus. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher using it, the spell save DC increases by 1. The crystal cracks slightly each time — it has seven cracks left before it shatters.

name: Cloak of the Pale Traveller
description: While wearing this cloak, undead creatures ignore you unless you attack them or use magic in their presence. The effect breaks for 24 hours if you deal damage to an undead. Tomb-robbers and grave-wardens both covet this item, for entirely different reasons.

name: Bag of Useful Clutter
description: Reach into this bag and name any mundane item worth 1 gp or less — you pull it out, usable up to 5 times per day. Whatever comes out vanishes after 10 minutes if not used. Nobody is sure what is actually inside the bag.

name: Bag of Useful Oddments
description: Once per day, reach in and name a mundane object worth 5gp or less that fits in one hand. It is there. The bag refuses the same object twice in a week.

name: Lantern of the Narrow Path
description: Sheds bright light in a 30-foot cone only. Invisible creatures caught in the beam are outlined and cannot benefit from invisibility while they remain in it.

name: Cloak Pin of the Second Face
description: Three times per day, as an action, alter your appearance as though casting Disguise Self. The disguise persists for one hour or until dismissed.

name: Rope of the Willing Climb
description: Fifty feet of rope that moves on command, tying knots, anchoring itself to any surface and hauling up to 400 pounds at 20 feet per round.

name: Ledger of Small Debts
description: Any agreement written and signed in this book is known to both parties at all times, including how much remains owed. It cannot compel payment.

name: Figurine of the Patient Mule
description: A clay mule. Once per day, speak the word to make it a living mule for eight hours. It carries 500 pounds and will not fight.

name: Tankard of the Measured Draught
description: Fills with ale, wine or clean water on command, up to four pints a day. You cannot become drunk on what it produces unless you wish to be.

name: Eyes of the Backward Glance
description: A pair of smoked lenses. You cannot be Surprised, and attackers gain no advantage from being behind you.

name: Censer of the Settled Room
description: Burns for one hour. All creatures in a 20-foot radius that can smell it have advantage on saves against being Frightened and gain the benefit of a short rest in half the time.

name: Keystone of the Known Door
description: Touch it to a door to attune it. Thereafter, once per day, you may teleport to that door from within one mile.

name: Mask of the Borrowed Tongue
description: While worn, you can speak and understand one language you have heard spoken in the last 24 hours. You cannot read it.

name: Hand of the Absent Servant
description: A carved wooden hand. At will, cast Mage Hand without components. The hand is invisible and can carry up to 20 pounds.

name: Pouch of Pocket Sand
description: Three uses per day. As an action, throw it at a creature within 10 feet: DC 13 Dexterity save or Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Quill of the Distant Correspondent
description: Paired with another quill. Anything written with one appears on paper beneath the other, anywhere in the world, up to one page per day.

name: Bedroll of the Deep Rest
description: You gain the full benefit of a long rest in six hours instead of eight, and you cannot be woken by sound alone.

name: Spindle of Grey Thread
description: Unspools up to one mile of thread, invisible to all but you. It never tangles and shows you the way back without fail.

name: Stone of the Settled Stomach
description: Held in the mouth, it neutralises any ingested poison or disease within one minute. Three uses, then it crumbles.

name: Hat of the Unremarkable Man
description: While worn, creatures that see you immediately forget your face on losing sight of you, unless they have known you for a year or more.

name: Crucible of the Lesser Melt
description: A thumb-sized bowl that melts any metal placed in it within one minute, without heat to the holder. It handles up to one pound at a time.

name: Boots of the Borrowed Hour
description: Once per day, take the Dash action as a bonus action and ignore difficult terrain and opportunity attacks for that movement.

name: Nail of the Held Door
description: Driven into any door or hatch, it holds it shut against DC 20 Strength. Pulling the nail free is a bonus action for the one who placed it.

name: Wreath of the Quiet Mind
description: You have advantage on Constitution saves made to maintain Concentration, and you cannot be forced to speak against your will.

name: Lens of the Long Look
description: A collapsing spyglass. You can see clearly up to one mile in daylight, and it grants advantage on Perception checks made to observe at a distance.

name: Shard of the Shared Sight
description: Snap it in two and give half away. Once per day, either holder may see through the other's eyes for one minute, at any distance on the same plane.

name: Bracelet of the Counted Breath
description: You can hold your breath for 15 minutes, and you automatically succeed on saves against suffocation while you have breath remaining.

name: Flask of the Carried Flame
description: Capture any fire within 5 feet as an action, extinguishing it. Pour it out later to restore the fire exactly as it was, up to a week afterwards.

name: Key of the Common Lock
description: Opens any nonmagical lock of simple construction with one minute of work and no check. Against quality locks it grants advantage instead.

name: Shovel of the Shallow Grave
description: Digs a 5-by-5-by-5-foot hole in one minute in any soil, and fills it back seamlessly in another. It will not dig through stone.

name: Collar of the Understood Beast
description: Placed on a willing Beast, you may speak with it and it with you, for as long as it wears the collar.

name: Mortar of the Parted Mixture
description: Grinding any substance in it separates the mixture into its components. Identifies poisons, adulterants and the contents of a potion.

name: Ribbon of the Marked Page
description: Placed in any book, you may recall any passage you have read in it at will, perfectly, without the book in hand.

name: Pendant of the Second Breath
description: Once per day, when you fail a death saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead. The pendant grows cold after use and must warm for 24 hours before the property is available again. It was made by a surgeon who lost too many patients.

name: Shadowsong Remnant Brooch
description: A tarnished brooch recovered from a Shadowsong safehouse. While wearing it, you can cast Invisibility on yourself once per day. In dim light or darkness, the duration is unlimited until you attack, cast a spell, or enter bright light. Possessing this is a criminal offence under DOL law.

name: Mirrorstone of the Divide
description: When held against a flat surface, this stone reveals a mirrored pocket dimension — an exact copy of the room inverted. You can enter and exit as an action; up to 5 willing creatures can follow. The copied room always looks slightly older than the original.

name: Crown of Sealed Mouths
description: A circlet of black iron that once per day lets you cast Silence centred on yourself without concentration — the silence moves with you. You are also immune to the Deafened condition. Constructed during the Muting, when the DOL silenced the lower districts for three days.

name: Boots of the Unbroken Path
description: These boots triple your overland travel pace on foot and grant immunity to difficult terrain during movement. You cannot be magically slowed, and once per day you can take the Dash action as a free action.

name: Bell of the Broken Circle
description: Rung as an action, it dispels one magical effect of 3rd level or lower within 30 feet, chosen by you. Recharges at dawn.

name: Cube of Taken Ground
description: Place the cube and speak the word to create a 20-foot cube of extradimensional space with one door, lasting eight hours. Hostile creatures cannot enter uninvited.

name: Portrait of the Other Room
description: A framed painting of an empty room. As an action, step into the painting, where you may remain safely for up to one hour before being expelled.

name: Hand of Glory and Debt
description: A preserved hand holding a candle. While lit, you can cast Knock and Detect Magic at will, but you age one day for every minute it burns.

name: Clockwork Understudy
description: A brass figure that becomes a perfect replica of you for one hour, once per day. It obeys simple standing instructions and has AC 13 and 20 hit points.

name: Helm of the Second Opinion
description: Three times per day, after rolling an ability check, you may reroll it and take the better result.

name: Lantern of the Cut Shadow
description: Sheds bright light in 40 feet. Creatures within the light cannot turn invisible, teleport, or benefit from illusion magic.

name: Needle of the Unpicked Spell
description: Three charges, regained at dawn. As an action, spend a charge to end one ongoing spell effect of 4th level or lower on a creature or object you touch.

name: Jar of the Caught Voice
description: Captures the next sixty seconds of sound when opened. Replays perfectly on command, and can imitate a captured voice well enough to fool those who know it.

name: Saddle of the Far Road
description: A mount bearing this saddle travels at four times its normal pace overland and leaves no tracks. Neither mount nor rider tires on the journey.

name: Hourglass of the Spent Minute
description: Once per day, turn it to grant yourself one additional action on your turn. The glass cracks a little more with each use; after twenty, it is done.

name: Mantle of the Watchful Dead
description: Once per day, speak with a corpse as though casting Speak with Dead, with no material component and no limit on how long it has been dead.

name: Brazier of the Called Servant
description: Once per day, summon an invisible servant with 30 hit points that obeys you for one hour. It can fight, carrying out simple attacks at +5 for 1d8 force damage.

name: Monocle of the Weighed Word
description: While worn, you know when a creature you can see and hear deliberately lies to you, though not what the truth is.

name: Sandglass of the Still Room
description: Once per day, freeze a 30-foot radius in time for one round: nothing within may act, move or be affected, including you.

name: Boots of the Stolen Step
description: Four charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Misty Step, or three to cast Dimension Door, without a spell slot.

name: Chest of the Divided Hoard
description: Holds 500 pounds in a space the size of a hatbox, weighing always 10 pounds. Only those you name can open it; others find it empty.

name: Crown of the Borrowed Skill
description: Once per long rest, touch a willing creature and gain proficiency in one skill it is proficient in, for eight hours.

name: Fan of the Turned Weather
description: Three charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Gust of Wind, two for Fog Cloud at 4th level, or three to clear all weather within a half mile for an hour.

name: Reliquary of the Held Wound
description: As an action, transfer up to 30 points of damage from a willing creature into the reliquary. It holds the wound for 24 hours, then returns it to that creature unless emptied by a Lesser Restoration.

name: Spindle of the Unspun Hour
description: Once per day, after you take damage, you may undo the last six seconds: you return to the position and hit points you had at the start of your previous turn.

name: Scales of the True Worth
description: Any object placed on the scales reveals its true market value, its magical nature if any, and whether it is stolen.

name: Mask of the Hollow Choir
description: Once per day, as an action, you may speak with the voices of a hundred people: all creatures within 60 feet make a DC 15 Wisdom save or be Frightened of you for one minute.

name: Compass of the Named Thing
description: Name an object or creature you have personally seen. The needle points toward it for one hour, if it is within 100 miles. Once per day.

name: Gloves of the Second Craft
description: You gain proficiency with all artisan's tools, and you work at four times the normal speed on any crafting project.

name: Candelabra of the Watched Door
description: Set it down and name a boundary up to 60 feet across. For eight hours you know the moment anything crosses it, and in which direction.

name: Lockbox of the Deferred Hour
description: Anything placed inside experiences no passage of time. A dying creature's parts, a lit fuse, a spoiling meal, all are held exactly as they were.

name: Lightcatcher Prism
description: Hold this prism toward sunlight as an action to store solar energy. Release it as an action: a 60-foot cone deals 8d8 radiant damage (DC 16 Dexterity save, half on success) and permanently dispels any magical darkness it touches. Must recharge in direct sunlight for 8 hours.

name: Mantle of the Interred
description: While wearing this grey shroud, you can move through solid earth and stone at half speed and breathe normally while submerged in earth. If you end your turn inside solid matter, you are shunted to the nearest empty space and take 5d6 force damage.

name: Hourglass of Taken Time
