description: Once per day, turn this hourglass as a bonus action to duplicate the next action you take — the action resolves, then immediately resolves again as though you had acted twice. The sand inside flows upward.

name: The Ninth Door
description: A folded paper door. Unfold it against any wall to create a passage to any place you have personally visited on this plane. Once per day, one-way, lasting one minute.

name: Reliquary of the Unspent Life
description: Holds the last breath of a willing dying creature. Breaking it restores a dead creature to life as though by Raise Dead, with no material cost. One use, then it is glass.

name: Crown of the Thousand Clerks
description: You can read, write and speak every language. You recall perfectly everything you have read while wearing it, and gain advantage on all Intelligence checks.

name: Lamp of the Divided Self
description: Once per day, create a duplicate of yourself with your statistics and half your hit points. It acts on your initiative under your control for ten minutes.

name: Loom of the Rewoven Hour
description: Once per day, as a reaction to any event you witnessed in the last minute, force that event to be rerolled entirely. All participants reroll their dice.

name: Coffer of the Stolen Season
description: Opened, it releases a season into a one-mile radius for 24 hours: deep winter, high summer, driving autumn or false spring. Recharges on the new moon.

name: Orrery of the Borrowed Sky
description: As an action, you may cast Scrying without components, targeting anywhere you can name on this plane. Three times per day.

name: Mantle of the Many Dead
description: Once per day, call the shades of five creatures that died within 100 feet in the last century. They fight for one minute as Shadows under your control.

name: Heartglass
description: A glass holding a slow red tide. While it is full you cannot die: damage that would kill you empties the glass instead. It refills over seven days.

name: Gate-Key of the Four Thresholds
description: Attune the key to up to four doors you have touched. Thereafter, any door you unlock with it opens onto one of those four, at will.

name: Censer of the Unmade Wound
description: Burned for one minute, it heals all creatures of your choice within 30 feet for 8d8 hit points and removes one condition from each. Recharges at dawn.

name: The Weighing Chain
description: Bind a creature with the chain and ask it three questions. It must answer truthfully or take 6d10 psychic damage per refusal. Once per day, DC 17 Charisma save to resist each question.

name: Atlas of the Walked World
description: The book maps itself as you travel. Once per day, point to any mapped page to teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures there.

name: Shroud of the Unspoken Name
description: Your true name cannot be learned, spoken or used against you by any means. Magic that requires knowing your name automatically fails.

name: The Patient Mirror
description: Shows any place or creature you name, as it is now, for one minute. Three times per day. Anything that notices it is being watched may look back.

name: Furnace Heart
description: A fist-sized coal that never cools. You are immune to fire, and as an action may release a 60-foot cone of flame for 10d6 fire damage, DC 17 Dexterity save for half. Recharges at dawn.

name: Keystone of the Held Wall
description: Once per day, as an action, raise a wall of stone 60 feet long, 20 feet high and 2 feet thick anywhere you can see within 120 feet. It is permanent until broken.

name: Codex of the Argued Case
description: Once per day, present an argument to a creature that can understand you. It must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom save or be convinced of your position for 24 hours, short of self-harm.

name: The Standing Hour
description: Once per day, stop time for everyone but yourself for three rounds, as the Time Stop spell. Using it ages you one month.

name: The Ledger of All Debts
description: Once per day, write a creature's name in the ledger and choose an amount of hit points (up to 50). That creature immediately loses those hit points, and you gain them. The ledger has 99 pages — entries cannot be erased. The 100th page is already written, in your handwriting.

name: The Stolen Hour
description: Once per day, shatter this ornate pocket watch as an action. For 6 seconds (one round), time stops for all other creatures. You may move and take one action but cannot deal damage or directly affect other creatures. The watch repairs itself at midnight — always exactly one hour before dawn.

name: The Last Ledger
description: Write any debt in this book and both parties know it exactly. A debt unpaid by the named date transfers the debtor's hit point maximum, permanently, to the creditor, up to 50 points.

name: The Opened Door
description: A door frame that folds to the size of a coin. Erected, it opens onto any plane or location you can name, for up to one hour. Recharges after seven days.

name: Crown of the Unanswered King
description: Creatures within 60 feet that can see you must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom save or treat you as their rightful sovereign for one hour. Once per day; those who save are immune for a year.

name: The Hollow Heart
description: Remove your heart and keep it in this box. While it is hidden and intact you cannot die by any means, but you cannot be healed above half your hit point maximum, and you feel nothing at all.

name: The Unwritten Page
description: Write one sentence of fact on this page. It becomes true, if it does not contradict another creature's will or restore the dead. The page then turns to ash. There is only ever one page.

name: Loom of the Fated Thread
description: Once per week, choose a creature and a single die roll it will make in the next 24 hours. You decide the result of that roll in advance.

name: The Gathering Lantern
description: Once per day, call every creature that has died within one mile in the last year. They appear as spirits for one hour and will answer, though not always helpfully.

name: Vault of the Kept Year
description: A door-sized extradimensional space with no time passing inside. Those sheltering within emerge not a moment older, however long they stayed. Opening it takes one minute and cannot be hurried.

name: The Reckoning Scales
description: Place two creatures' blood on the pans. The one found wanting takes 100 psychic damage; the other is healed to full and gains immunity to all damage for one minute. Once per month.

name: The Unbroken Circle
description: A ring of chalk that draws itself to any size up to 60 feet. Nothing hostile crosses it, in either direction, for 24 hours. Not even a Wish will open it.

name: The Sum of All Debts
description: Once per month, call in every obligation owed to you. Each creature that owes you anything, knowingly or not, must travel to you with all speed or take 10d10 psychic damage daily until it does.

name: Heart of the Standing Engine
description: While carried, you need not eat, drink, breathe or sleep, you do not age, and you automatically stabilise at 0 hit points. If removed from you for a week, you die.

name: Ring of the Unlit Flame
description: While wearing this ring, you can produce a small flame from your fingertip at will. The flame gives off no heat and does not ignite flammable material — it is light only. Useful. Strange.

name: Ring of the Steady Hand
description: Your hands do not tremble from fear, poison, or cold while wearing this ring. You have advantage on checks and saves against effects that would cause your hands to shake or lose fine motor control. Favoured by surgeons, forgers, and poisoners alike.

name: Ring of the Dry Hand
description: Your hands never sweat, shake or slip. You have advantage on checks made to keep hold of something in difficult conditions.

name: Ring of the Counted Step
description: You always know exactly how far you have walked since you last rested, and how far you are from where you started.

name: Band of the Minor Mend
description: Once per day, as an action, repair a single break, tear or crack in an object no larger than a shield.

name: Ring of the Rising Hour
description: You always wake at a time you set before sleeping, alert and without grogginess, no matter how tired you are.

name: Signet of the Unforged Seal
description: Presses a seal into wax that cannot be copied, forged or lifted intact. Anyone who has seen your true seal knows a fake on sight.

name: Ring of Small Flame
description: At will, produce a flame the size of a candle from your fingertip. It gives light but no useful heat and cannot ignite anything larger than tinder.

name: Ring of the Tasted Cup
description: The band darkens when brought within an inch of poisoned food or drink. It does not detect disease or magical contamination.

name: Fisher's Ring of Still Water
description: Water within 5 feet of you grows glassy and still. You have advantage on checks to see into or through water.

name: Ring of the Even Temper
description: You cannot be goaded into violence by mundane provocation, and you have advantage on checks to keep your composure under insult.

name: Band of the Marked Hour
description: You always know the precise time of day and the date, even underground, asleep or on another plane.

name: Ring of the Quiet Joint
description: Your armour, boots and gear make no creak, jingle or rattle. You still make noise through movement itself.

name: Ring of the Shared Warmth
description: You and one creature you touch remain comfortable in cold weather down to freezing, for as long as you remain within 10 feet.

name: Carter's Ring of the Light Load
description: Everything you carry weighs one quarter as much to you. Its actual weight is unchanged for everyone else.

name: Ring of the Clean Edge
description: Any blade you hold stays sharp, unstained and free of rust, no matter what it has cut.

name: Ring of the Second Guess
description: Once per day, you may ask the ring whether a course of action you are about to take is obviously dangerous. It answers yes, no, or unclear.

name: Band of the Unlit Room
description: You can see in dim light within 30 feet as though it were bright light. You gain no benefit in total darkness.

name: Ring of the Held Tongue
description: You cannot be compelled to speak by nonmagical means, and you never talk in your sleep.

name: Ring of the Settled Gut
description: You are immune to seasickness, vertigo and nausea from motion, and you have advantage on saves against being sickened by smell.

name: Ring of the Found Coin
description: Once per day, searching a place where coins might plausibly be lost turns up 1d10 copper pieces that genuinely were.

name: Ring of the Named Stranger
description: You never forget a face or a name you have been told. Recalling where and when you met someone requires no check.

name: Band of the Weathered Hand
description: Your skin resists blister, burn and frost from nonmagical sources. You can handle hot kettles and cold iron bare-handed.

name: Ring of the Steady Flame
description: Any fire, lamp or candle within 10 feet of you cannot be blown out by wind, nor doused by rain.

name: Ring of the Kept Scent
description: You give off no scent at all. Creatures tracking you by smell have disadvantage, and dogs lose your trail entirely.

name: Ring of the Low Bough
description: Branches, brambles and undergrowth part as you pass. You ignore difficult terrain caused by vegetation.

name: Ring of the Honest Weight
description: You can judge the exact weight of anything you lift, and whether a container holds what it claims to hold.

name: Ring of the Unslipped Knot
description: Any knot you tie holds until you untie it. You have advantage on checks involving rope, rigging and binding.

name: Band of the Watchful Finger
description: The ring tightens once when a creature you cannot see comes within 10 feet of you. It cannot tell you where.

name: Ring of the Cold Cellar
description: Food and drink within 5 feet of you does not spoil. Over a week, this can keep a larder or a body.

name: Ring of the Open Page
description: You read twice as fast as normal and never lose your place. Marginal notes you make appear in your own hand even when you did not write them.

name: Ring of the Hollow Note
description: Rap any surface with the ring to learn whether there is a cavity behind it within one foot. It cannot say how large.

name: Ring of the Mended Thread
description: Clothing you wear repairs itself overnight, short of being destroyed outright. It does not clean itself.

name: Ring of the Narrow Gap
description: You can squeeze through any opening a cat could manage, given one minute and no armour. Your gear must be passed separately.

name: Ring of the Quiet Beast
description: Ordinary animals do not raise an alarm at your approach. Trained guard animals and Beasts of CR 1 or higher are unaffected.

name: Band of the Last Candle
description: Once per day, when a light source you carry goes out, the ring relights it instantly.

name: Tarnished Ring of Warnings
description: This ring tightens slightly when you are being watched or followed by a creature that intends you harm, and grants a +2 bonus to Initiative. It was crafted by someone who was betrayed more than once and survived.

name: Ring of the Second Skin
description: While wearing this ring, your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage and count as magical. Additionally, you can cast Mage Armor on yourself once per day without a spell slot. The ring leaves no mark on the finger despite being decades old.

name: Ring of Borrowed Voice
description: Once per day, touch a willing or incapacitated creature and press this ring to their throat. For 1 hour your voice sounds exactly like theirs, and you gain advantage on Deception checks while mimicking them. The effect ends early if the original speaker is within 30 feet and speaks.

name: Ring of Warning
description: You cannot be Surprised while conscious, and you have advantage on initiative rolls when combat begins within 30 feet of you.

name: Ring of the Lesser Veil
description: Three times per day, cast Disguise Self at will. The illusion also conceals your voice.

name: Ring of Thin Air
description: You can breathe normally at any altitude, in thin air, foul air or smoke. You are immune to inhaled poisons.

name: Ring of the Turned Blade
description: Once per short rest, when hit by a melee weapon attack, you may use your reaction to reduce the damage by 2d8.

name: Ring of the Borrowed Step
description: Twice per day, as a bonus action, teleport up to 15 feet to a space you can see.

name: Ring of the Spoken Word
description: You can speak and understand one language of your choice, changed on each long rest. You cannot read it.

name: Ring of the Sure Foot
description: You can walk on walls and ceilings at half speed for up to ten minutes per day, as though they were level ground.

name: Ring of Minor Elements
description: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder on each long rest. You have resistance to that damage type for the day.

name: Ring of the Shared Hurt
description: Paired with a second ring. Damage taken by either wearer may be split evenly between both, at the injured party's choice.

name: Ring of the Open Lock
description: Three charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Knock. The ring is warm against the skin for a minute afterwards.

name: Ring of the Still Pool
description: You have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed and can breathe underwater for up to one hour per day.

name: Ring of Thieves' Fortune
description: Once per short rest, reroll a failed Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) or Dexterity (Stealth) check and take the new result.

name: Ring of the Hidden Pocket
description: Holds up to one cubic foot and 10 pounds in an extradimensional space. Retrieving an item is a bonus action; nobody searching you finds it.

name: Ring of the Sentinel's Eye
description: You can see invisible creatures within 15 feet of you, and you have advantage on saves against illusions.

name: Ring of the Measured Fall
description: You take no damage from falls and always land on your feet, descending at 60 feet per round as though Feather Falling.

name: Ring of the Second Breath
description: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, regain hit points equal to 2d8 plus your level.

name: Ring of the Marked Trail
description: Attune to a place by standing in it for one minute. Thereafter the ring always points toward it, at any distance on this plane.

name: Ring of the Weighted Word
description: You have advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made against a creature that has accepted food, drink or shelter from you in the last day.

name: Ring of Cold Iron
description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and abilities used by Fey, and such creatures cannot charm you.

name: Ring of the Fed Fire
description: Three charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Burning Hands, or two to cast Scorching Ray.

name: Ring of the Kept Secret
description: Magic cannot read your thoughts or compel you to reveal a secret you have deliberately set aside while wearing it.

name: Ring of the Spare Hand
description: At will, summon a spectral third hand that can hold an item, work a catch or carry 20 pounds. It cannot attack.

name: Ring of Small Mercy
description: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you may choose to knock it unconscious instead with no penalty, even with a spell or ranged attack.

name: Ring of the Three Questions
description: Once per day, ask the ring a question about an object you are touching. It answers one of: who made it, who last held it, or what it is for.

name: Ring of the Loyal Hound
description: Once per day, summon a spectral hound for one hour. It has the statistics of a Wolf, obeys you, and vanishes at 0 hit points.

name: Ring of the Clear Head
description: You are immune to the effects of alcohol and nonmagical drugs, and you have advantage on saves against being Charmed or Frightened.

name: Ring of the Absent Weight
description: Once per day, for one minute, you weigh nothing: you may walk on snow, water and thin branches, and cannot be shoved or grappled by Small creatures.

name: Ring of the Reversed Lock
description: Any door, box or lock you close becomes magically locked, requiring a DC 17 check to open. You may unlock it at will from any distance within 100 feet.

name: Ring of the Unbroken Watch
description: You need only four hours of sleep for a full long rest, and you remain dimly aware of your surroundings while sleeping.

name: Ring of the Swallowed Sound
description: Once per short rest, create a 15-foot radius of absolute silence centred on you for one minute. You may dismiss it as a bonus action.

name: Ring of the Opened Vein
description: Once per day, as an action, sacrifice 1d10 of your own hit points to heal a creature you touch for twice that amount.

name: Ring of the Tethered Soul
description: While attuned to this ring alongside a designated partner, when either of you fails a saving throw, the other can use a reaction to grant a reroll. Each creature can use this property once per short rest. The rings pulse warmly when used.

name: Ring of the Pale Dominion
description: While wearing this ring, undead of CR 2 or lower not already under another's control regard you as their master. You can command up to 10 such creatures at once as a bonus action. The ring is carved from bone — it is unclear whose.

name: Ring of Stored Pain
description: Each time you take damage while wearing this ring, 2 points of it are stored (max 30). As a bonus action, release all stored pain in a 20-foot cone — creatures in range take necrotic damage equal to the stored amount (DC 15 Constitution save, half on success). The ring grows warm as it fills.

name: Ring of the Lingering Thread
description: If you die while wearing this ring, your soul remains in it for seven days, able to speak with anyone holding it, and can be returned to a body by any resurrection magic in that time.

name: Ring of the Fourfold Ward
description: Four charges, regained at dawn. As a reaction, spend one to gain a +4 bonus to AC against one attack, or to one saving throw.

name: Ring of the Walked Wall
description: Once per day, as an action, pass through up to 10 feet of nonmagical stone, wood or earth as though it were not there.

name: Ring of Displaced Sight
description: Your image appears two feet from your true location. Attacks against you have disadvantage until you are hit, resetting at the start of your next turn.

name: Ring of the Three Shadows
description: Once per short rest, create three illusory duplicates that mirror your movements for one minute. An attack has a chance to strike a duplicate instead of you.

name: Ring of the Burning Debt
description: When a creature damages you, it takes fire damage equal to one quarter of the damage dealt. You cannot turn this off.

name: Ring of the Borrowed Spell
description: Once per day, as a reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell of 3rd level or lower, you may learn it until your next long rest and cast it once.

name: Ring of the Even Keel
description: You cannot be moved against your will, knocked Prone, Grappled or Restrained by any creature of your size or smaller.

name: Ring of the Grave-Quiet
description: Undead of CR 3 or lower must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be unable to attack you. Once per day, you may command one such creature for one hour.

name: Ring of the Counted Life
description: You always know the exact current hit points of any creature you have damaged in the last minute.

name: Ring of Four Winds
description: You gain a flying speed of 30 feet for a total of ten minutes per day, divisible as you wish. The ring grows cold as the time runs out.

name: Ring of the Divided Mind
description: You may concentrate on two spells at once. You make Concentration saves separately for each, with disadvantage on both.

name: Ring of Unspent Pain
description: Damage you take is delayed until the end of your next turn, arriving all at once. If you are healed before then, the delayed damage is reduced by the amount healed.

name: Ring of the Spoken Gate
description: Three charges, regained at dawn. Spend one for Misty Step, two for Dimension Door, or three to return to a place you attuned to on your last long rest.

name: Ring of the Honest Bargain
description: An agreement sworn aloud while you wear this binds both parties magically. Breaking it inflicts 6d6 psychic damage and disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours.

name: Ring of the Hollow Hunger
description: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to its Constitution score, lasting one hour.

name: Ring of the Widened Pupil
description: You gain darkvision to 120 feet and can see through magical darkness. Three times per day, cast See Invisibility as a bonus action.

name: Ring of the Steady Casting
description: You automatically succeed on Concentration saves against damage of 15 or less, and you have advantage on all other Concentration saves.

name: Ring of the Quartered Wound
description: Three times per day, as a reaction to taking damage, reduce it by half. You may not use this on the same attack as any other damage reduction.

name: Ring of the Loaned Face
description: At will, assume the exact appearance, voice and mannerisms of any humanoid you have seen. Truesight and a DC 18 Insight check see through it.

name: Ring of the Mirrored Spell
description: Once per day, when a spell of 4th level or lower targets only you and you succeed on the save, the spell is redirected at its caster instead.

name: Ring of the Spent Hour
description: Once per day, as a bonus action, take an additional action on your turn. You then gain one level of exhaustion until your next long rest.

name: Ring of the Low Road
description: You have a burrowing speed of 20 feet through earth, sand and loose stone, leaving a tunnel behind you that collapses after one minute.

name: Ring of the Gathered Will
description: You add your Charisma modifier to all saving throws against spells, to a minimum of +1.

name: Ring of the Hardened Hide
description: You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons, and your unarmoured AC is at least 15.

name: Ring of the Thousand Keys
description: You may open any nonmagical lock by touch as an action, and you know at a glance whether a door is trapped, barred or watched.

name: Ring of the Unbroken
description: While wearing this ring, you have advantage on death saving throws, and rolling a natural 20 on one restores you to 1 hit point instantly. Once per long rest, when you would be reduced to 0 hit points, you can choose to drop to 1 instead.

name: Ring of the Sundered Eye
description: While wearing this ring, you can see invisible creatures and objects and perceive into the Ethereal Plane out to 60 feet. Once per day, cast True Seeing on yourself (no concentration, 10 minutes). One iris becomes silver — permanently.

name: Ring of the Held Breath
description: When you would drop to 0 hit points, you instead drop to 1 and gain immunity to all damage until the end of your next turn. Recharges at dawn.

name: Ring of Three Wishes Withheld
description: Holds three charges that never recharge. Spend one to cast any spell of 5th level or lower you can name. When the last is spent, the ring crumbles.

name: Ring of the Open Sky
description: You gain a flying speed of 60 feet with hover, and you can cast Wind Walk once per day without a spell slot.

name: Ring of the Turned Season
description: You are immune to cold and fire damage, and you can alter the temperature in a 60-foot radius by up to forty degrees at will.

name: Ring of the Swallowed Spell
description: Once per day, as a reaction, absorb a spell of 5th level or lower targeting you. You take no effect, and regain a spell slot of that level if you can.

name: Ring of the Shared Life
description: Paired. While both wearers live, each has hit points equal to the average of the two, recalculated whenever either takes damage or is healed.

name: Ring of the Hollow Crown
description: Once per day, force a creature within 60 feet to make a DC 17 Wisdom save or be Charmed for one hour, obeying your spoken commands short of self-harm.

name: Ring of the Nine Lives
description: Set with nine small stones. When you fail a death saving throw, a stone shatters and the throw becomes a success instead.

name: Ring of the Still Hour
description: Once per day, cast Time Stop as though a 9th-level caster, but you may take only one round of actions.

name: Ring of the Unseen Walk
description: You may become invisible at will as a bonus action. The invisibility ends when you attack or cast a spell, and cannot resume for one minute.

name: Ring of the Riven Earth
description: Once per day, as an action, shatter the ground in a 30-foot radius: 8d6 bludgeoning damage, DC 17 Dexterity save for half, and the area becomes difficult terrain.

name: Ring of the Kept Year
description: You do not age while wearing it, and you are immune to magical aging. Removing it does not restore the years you did not spend.

name: Ring of the Counted Death
description: Name a creature at dawn. You know whether it lives, and if it dies that day you know the hour and manner of its death.

name: Ring of the Opened Mind
description: You can read the surface thoughts of any creature within 30 feet at will, with a DC 17 Wisdom save to resist. Creatures are unaware of the intrusion.

name: Ring of the Folded Road
description: Three times per day, cast Dimension Door. Once per week, cast Teleport. The ring will not carry anything unwilling.

name: Ring of the Bound Element
description: Holds a bound elemental. Once per day, release it to fight for you for ten minutes as a Water, Air, Earth or Fire Elemental, chosen when the ring is made.

name: Ring of the Given Word
description: Once per day, swear an oath aloud. Until you fulfil or break it, you gain advantage on all rolls directly serving that oath, and disadvantage on all rolls that work against it.

name: Ring of the Last Ward
description: You have advantage on all saving throws. Once per day, when you fail one anyway, you may choose to succeed instead.

name: Ring of Eclipse Dominion
description: While wearing this ring, you can cast Dominate Monster (DC 19) once per day. Against Undead, the save DC is 23 and the effect is permanent until dispelled. You also cannot be Charmed or Dominated by any effect. The ring is warm at noon and ice-cold at midnight — always, regardless of environment.

name: The Ring of Shut Doors
description: No creature may teleport, planeshift, or magically travel into or out of a 60-foot radius around you. You may lower this as a bonus action.

name: Ring of the Hundred Years
description: You stop aging entirely and are immune to death by old age, disease and poison. Each decade worn, you forget one year of your life, chosen by the ring.

name: Ring of the Turned Hour
description: Once per week, rewind time by one minute. Everyone returns to their position and condition of sixty seconds ago; only you remember what happened.

name: Ring of the Sundered Will
description: Once per day, a creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom save or obey a single command of up to ten words, even one that leads to its death.

name: Ring of the Unspent Self
description: You need not eat, drink, breathe or sleep, you cannot be Charmed, Frightened, Stunned or Paralysed, and you automatically succeed on all death saving throws.

name: The Shackle Ring
description: Bind one creature you can see and that can see you, DC 20 Charisma save. While bound, it cannot move more than 100 feet from you, and you take half of all damage it suffers.

name: Ring of the Gathered Storm
description: Twelve charges, regaining 1d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges to cast Lightning Bolt (3), Chain Lightning (6), or Storm of Vengeance (9). You are immune to lightning and thunder.

name: Ring of the Second Life
description: When you die while wearing it, you return to life at dawn with half your hit points, in the place you last took a long rest. The ring then becomes ordinary gold.

name: Ring of the Open Hand of Kings
description: Allies within 30 feet who can see you gain advantage on all saving throws and immunity to being Frightened. You may extend your own immunities to one ally at a time.

name: Ring of the Absent Name
description: You cannot be scried, located, tracked, divined or remembered by anyone who has not met you in person. All records of you fade within a month of being written.

name: The Reckoner's Band
description: Once per day, choose a creature you can see. For one minute, all damage it deals is also dealt to itself, and all healing it receives is halved. DC 20 Charisma save to resist.

name: Sunrod of the DOL
description: A metal rod issued to DOL officials that functions as a torch on command. Once per day it emits a blinding flash — creatures within 10 feet must make a DC 11 Constitution save or be Blinded until the end of their next turn. Standard-issue, rarely respected.

name: Wand of Muffled Passage
description: This wand has 5 charges (recharges fully each dawn). Expend a charge to cast Silence (10-foot sphere, no concentration) centred on a point you touch, lasting 1 minute. Useful for arguments, escapes, and surgery.

name: Wand of the Lit Wick
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Light, or to ignite any flammable object within 30 feet.

name: Rod of the Measured Yard
description: Extends to any length up to 10 feet on command and locks rigid, bearing 300 pounds. Useful as a pole, a prop or a bridge rail.

name: Wand of Small Noises
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Minor Illusion, creating sound only.

name: Staff of the Steady Walk
description: A walking staff. You ignore difficult terrain caused by mud, scree or snow, and cannot be knocked Prone while both feet and the staff are planted.

name: Wand of the Mended Page
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Mend on an object no larger than a shield.

name: Rod of the Cold Spot
description: Chills a 5-foot radius to just above freezing for one hour, once per day. It will keep a body, a brew or a wound.

name: Wand of the Thrown Voice
description: At will, make your voice appear to come from any point within 60 feet that you can see.

name: Staff of the Found Path
description: Planted in the ground, it leans toward the nearest road or settlement within five miles. If none exists, it falls over.

name: Rod of the Honest Depth
description: Dipped into water, mud or grain, it reports the exact depth and whether anything solid lies at the bottom.

name: Wand of the Caught Fly
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to immobilise a Tiny creature or insect within 30 feet for one minute, unharmed.

name: Staff of the Settled Dust
description: Struck on the ground, it clears all loose dust, ash and cobweb from a 20-foot radius. Once per hour.

name: Rod of the Quiet Room
description: Once per day, dampen all sound in a 10-foot radius for ten minutes. Conversation inside remains audible only within the area.

name: Wand of the Faint Trace
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Detect Magic, though it reveals only presence and direction, not school.

name: Staff of the Shepherd's Count
description: Knows how many living creatures are within 60 feet of you at any moment, though not where or what they are.

name: Rod of the Opened Jar
description: Touched to any stuck lid, cork, seal or hinge, it loosens it without force or damage. It has no effect on a lock.

name: Wand of the Spilled Ink
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to write up to one page of dictated text in your hand on any surface.

name: Staff of the Driven Stake
description: Drives a tent peg, nail or post fully into any ordinary ground or timber with a single tap and no sound.

name: Rod of the Even Flame
description: Held over a fire, it keeps the heat steady and smokeless for eight hours. A campfire so tended cannot be smelled beyond 30 feet.

name: Wand of the Small Shock
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one to deal 1d4 lightning damage to a creature you touch, no attack roll required.

name: Staff of the Marked Mile
description: Notches itself once for every mile you walk with it, and the notches never fill. It will not count a mile travelled by cart or horse.

name: Rod of the Turned Needle
description: Points unerringly toward the nearest worked metal within 100 feet, buried or hidden.

name: Wand of the Borrowed Chill
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Ray of Frost.

name: Staff of the Reached Shelf
description: Extends to 15 feet and bears a hooked end. It can retrieve or push an object weighing up to 20 pounds at that distance.

name: Rod of the Honest Line
description: Shows true level, plumb and square against any surface. You have advantage on checks to detect a sloping floor or a false wall.

name: Wand of the Grey Smoke
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to fill a 10-foot cube with harmless grey smoke for one minute, lightly obscuring it.

name: Staff of the Pilgrim's Rest
description: Planted upright, it stands unaided and marks a 10-foot radius in which sleepers are not troubled by insects, damp or cold.

name: Rod of the Counted Coin
description: Passed over a pile of coins, it reports the exact value and whether any are counterfeit.

name: Wand of the Cleaned Hand
description: At will, clean one object, garment or creature no larger than Medium, as the Prestidigitation cantrip.

name: Staff of the Low Branch
description: Once per day, cause a tree within 30 feet to lower a branch to within reach, holding it there for one minute.

name: Rod of the Taken Scent
description: Waved through the air, it holds the scents of a place for one day. Presented to a tracking animal, it conveys them perfectly.

name: Wand of the Snuffed Light
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to extinguish all nonmagical light sources within a 20-foot radius.

name: Staff of the Stubborn Knot
description: Rope wound around it cannot slip, fray or be untied by anyone but you. It holds up to 600 pounds.

name: Rod of the Named Herb
description: Touched to any plant, it names the species and whether it is edible, medicinal or poisonous.

name: Wand of the Rattled Door
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to make any door, window or shutter within 60 feet shake violently for one round.

name: Ashwood Staff of Communion
description: A staff carved from a tree that survived a wildfire, with 8 charges (regains 1d6+1 at dawn). Cast Speak with Animals (1 charge) or Speak with Dead (3 charges). Animals seem to recognise it and are not hostile to its bearer.

name: Rod of Echoed Thunder
description: A short iron rod with 6 charges. Strike a surface to send a shockwave in a 30-foot line — creatures in range take 2d6 thunder damage and must succeed on a DC 13 Strength save or be pushed 10 feet back. Recharges 1d4 charges at dawn.

name: Wand of Magic Bolts
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Magic Missile at 1st level, or spend up to three to cast it at a higher level.

name: Rod of the Held Guard
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. As a reaction, spend one to grant yourself or an ally within 30 feet a +5 bonus to AC against one attack.

name: Staff of the Green Word
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend one to cast Entangle, or two for Spike Growth.

name: Wand of the Opened Way
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Knock. The wand gives a loud and conspicuous crack each time.

name: Rod of the Turned Beast
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to force a Beast within 30 feet to make a DC 13 Wisdom save or flee from you for one minute.

name: Staff of Small Fires
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend one for Burning Hands, two for Scorching Ray, three for Fireball at 3rd level.

name: Wand of the Still Target
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Hold Person at 2nd level, DC 13.

name: Rod of the Second Shield
description: 4 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Shield as a reaction, without a spell slot.

name: Staff of the Walked Water
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Water Walk on up to three creatures for one hour.

name: Wand of the Hidden Eye
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Detect Invisibility within 60 feet for ten minutes.

name: Rod of the Spoken Spark
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Shocking Grasp at 2nd level, or two to cast Witch Bolt.

name: Staff of the Held Breath
description: 4 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to grant a creature you touch the ability to breathe water for one hour.

name: Wand of the Pulled Thread
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to disarm a creature within 30 feet, DC 13 Strength save, sending the item 15 feet in a direction you choose.

name: Rod of the Silvered Tongue
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to gain advantage on a Charisma check, or to cast Charm Person at DC 13.

name: Staff of the Lesser Veil
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one for Disguise Self, two for Invisibility on yourself.

name: Wand of the Found Thing
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Locate Object, naming something you have personally handled.

name: Rod of the Fixed Wound
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend one to cast Cure Wounds at 1st level, or more to cast it at higher levels.

name: Staff of Thorn and Bramble
description: Functions as a +1 quarterstaff. 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn; spend one to cause thorns to erupt in a 10-foot radius, dealing 2d4 piercing damage.

name: Wand of the Mirrored Image
description: 4 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Mirror Image on yourself.

name: Rod of the Sealed Door
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Arcane Lock on a door, chest or window permanently until dispelled.

name: Staff of the Cold Current
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one for Ray of Frost at 2nd level, two for a 15-foot cone dealing 3d8 cold damage, DC 13 Constitution save for half.

name: Wand of the Shared Sight
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to see through the eyes of a willing creature within one mile for ten minutes.

name: Rod of the Lesser Banishment
description: 2 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to force a summoned or conjured creature within 60 feet to make a DC 13 Charisma save or be dismissed.

name: Staff of the Loud Word
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Thunderwave at 2nd level, DC 13.

name: Wand of the Pinned Shadow
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to pin a creature's shadow within 30 feet: DC 13 Strength save or its speed is 0 for one minute.

name: Staff of the Carried Load
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Floating Disk, which follows you for one hour and bears 500 pounds.

name: Wand of the Early Warning
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Alarm over a 30-foot cube, lasting eight hours and audible only to you.

name: Rod of Four Directions
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Gust of Wind, or to push a single creature within 30 feet 15 feet in any direction, DC 13 Strength save.

name: Staff of the Light Foot
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Jump, or two to cast Longstrider on up to three creatures.

name: Wand of the Dulled Blade
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to impose disadvantage on all attack rolls made by one creature within 60 feet until the end of its next turn, DC 13 Wisdom save.

name: Wand of Unravelling
description: A thin bone wand with 7 charges. Expend charges to cast Dispel Magic (1 charge per spell level targeted). If you expend 4+ charges at once, the target also cannot regain concentration until the end of their next turn. Recharges 1d6+1 charges at dawn.

name: Staff of the Pale Shepherd
description: A bleached wooden staff with 10 charges. Cast Animate Dead (3 charges, maximum HP), Speak with Dead (1 charge), or Inflict Wounds at 3rd level (2 charges). Recharges 1d8+2 charges at midnight. Undead animated with it obey without hesitation.

name: Nullwand
description: A featureless grey wand with 5 charges. Expend 1 charge as a reaction to Counterspell at 3rd level, or 2 charges for 5th level — no check required. Recharges 1d4 charges at dawn. Created during the DOL's anti-mage campaigns.

name: Staff of the Open Hand
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges to cast Cure Wounds (1), Lesser Restoration (2), Revivify (3) or Mass Healing Word (3).

name: Wand of Greater Bolts
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges to cast Magic Missile at up to 5th level, or spend 3 for Fireball at 3rd level.

name: Rod of the Turned Spell
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. As a reaction, spend one to cast Counterspell at 3rd level without a spell slot.

name: Staff of the Cold Hall
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Ice Knife (1), Hold Person (2), Sleet Storm (3) or Ice Storm (4). You have resistance to cold damage.

name: Wand of the Bound Will
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend charges for Command (1), Hold Person (2) or Dominate Beast (4). Save DC 15.

name: Rod of the Second Chance
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to reroll any d20 you have just rolled, or to force a creature within 60 feet to reroll one.

name: Staff of the Walked Air
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Feather Fall (1), Levitate (2), Fly (3) or Wind Walk (6).

name: Wand of the Unravelled Weave
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend three to cast Dispel Magic at 3rd level, or more charges to cast it at higher levels.

name: Rod of the Held Hour
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Slow, or two to cast Haste, without concentration.

name: Staff of the Grey Road
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Misty Step (2), Dimension Door (4) or Teleportation Circle (5).

name: Wand of the Hollow Voice
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend charges for Suggestion (2), Fear (3) or Confusion (4). Save DC 15.

name: Rod of the Standing Ward
description: 6 charges, regaining 1d4+2 at dawn. Spend charges for Shield (1), Blur (2), Protection from Energy (3) or Stoneskin (4).

name: Staff of the Risen Earth
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Earth Tremor (1), Erupting Earth (3), Wall of Stone (5) or Move Earth (6).

name: Wand of the Keen Eye
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend charges for Detect Magic (1), See Invisibility (2), Clairvoyance (3) or Arcane Eye (4).

name: Rod of the Severed Thread
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to force a creature Concentrating within 60 feet to make a DC 15 Constitution save or lose concentration.

name: Staff of the Gathering Dark
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Darkness (2), Blindness (2), Hunger of Hadar (3) or Evard's Black Tentacles (4). You have darkvision to 120 feet.

name: Wand of the Shifted Shape
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend four to cast Polymorph at DC 15, or one to cast Alter Self on yourself.

name: Rod of the Last Stand
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one as a reaction when an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points: they instead drop to 1.

name: Staff of the Rising Storm
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Thunderwave (1), Lightning Bolt (3), Call Lightning (3) or Destructive Wave (5).

name: Wand of the Cut Illusion
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one to reveal all illusions within 60 feet, or two to cast True Seeing on yourself for ten minutes.

name: Rod of the Taken Turn
description: 2 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to move one creature of your choice to the top of the initiative order for the next round.

name: Staff of the Woven Wall
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Wall of Fire (4), Wall of Water (3), Wall of Sand (3) or Wall of Force (5).

name: Wand of the Smothered Flame
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend one to extinguish all fire in a 30-foot radius and deal 4d6 cold damage to creatures made of fire there.

name: Rod of the Measured Fall
description: 6 charges, regaining 1d4+2 at dawn. Spend one to cast Feather Fall on up to five creatures, or three to reverse gravity in a 20-foot cube for one round.

name: Staff of the Quiet Mind
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Calm Emotions (2), Detect Thoughts (2), Mind Spike (2) or Dominate Person (5). Save DC 15.

name: Wand of the Shared Hurt
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend one to link two creatures within 60 feet for one minute: damage to either is dealt to both, DC 15 Charisma save to resist.

name: Rod of the Cracked Moon
description: A rod of pale stone etched with banned lunar sigils, holding 12 charges (recharges 1d10+2 at midnight). Cast Moonbeam (2), Darkness (1), Bane (1), Fear (2), or Modify Memory (5, DC 17). While holding it, you see in total darkness out to 60 feet.

name: Staff of the Divided World
description: One half sun-bleached bone, one half shadow-black ironwood, with 14 charges. Cast Wall of Light (2), Darkness (1), Sunburst (7), or Shadow of Moil (4). On a recharge roll of 1, an uncontrolled burst releases — roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

name: The Interpreter — Staff of All Tongues
description: While holding this staff, you understand all spoken and written language. Once per day, cast Modify Memory (DC 17) and choose to alter only the subject's memory of a specific conversation — speaking the replacement version into the staff beforehand.

name: Staff of the Open Sky
description: 20 charges, regaining 2d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Fly (3), Wind Wall (3), Control Weather (8) or Chain Lightning (6). You have a flying speed of 30 feet while holding it.

name: Rod of the Shut Mouth
description: 5 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Silence without concentration, or three to prevent all spellcasting in a 30-foot radius for one minute, DC 17.

name: Staff of the Sunlit Hour
description: 20 charges, regaining 2d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Daylight (3), Sunbeam (6) or Sunburst (8). Undead within 30 feet have disadvantage on saves against it.

name: Wand of the Unmade Thing
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4+1 at dawn. Spend three to cast Disintegrate at DC 17, or one to destroy a nonmagical object of up to 5 cubic feet.

name: Rod of the Fourfold Ward
description: You gain a +2 bonus to AC and all saving throws. 4 charges, regained at dawn; spend one as a reaction to automatically succeed on a failed save.

name: Staff of the Deep Current
description: 20 charges, regaining 2d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Tidal Wave (3), Control Water (4), Maelstrom (5) or Tsunami (8). You can breathe water.

name: Wand of the Bound Name
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Banishment at DC 17, or all three to banish a creature permanently if it fails three consecutive saves.

name: Rod of the Returned Hour
description: 2 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to undo the last round of combat entirely: all creatures return to their positions and hit points of one round ago.

name: Staff of the Burning World
description: 20 charges, regaining 2d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Fireball (3), Wall of Fire (4), Flame Strike (5), Delayed Blast Fireball (7) or Incendiary Cloud (8). Immunity to fire.

name: Wand of the Hollow Crown
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 at dawn. Spend charges for Dominate Person (5) or Mass Suggestion (6). Save DC 17. Each use leaves the wielder briefly unable to speak.

name: Rod of the Severed Plane
description: 4 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to prevent all teleportation and planar travel in a 60-foot radius for ten minutes, or three to cast Plane Shift.

name: Staff of the Written Word
description: 20 charges, regaining 2d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Comprehend Languages (1), Legend Lore (5), Contact Other Plane (5) or Commune (5). You can read any script.

name: Wand of the Gathered Dead
description: 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Animate Dead (3), Speak with Dead (3), Create Undead (6) or Finger of Death (7).

name: Rod of the Standing Order
description: 5 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to grant all allies within 30 feet advantage on attack rolls and saves until the end of your next turn.

name: Staff of the Thousand Thorns
description: 20 charges, regaining 2d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Spike Growth (2), Wall of Thorns (6), Blight (4) or Regenerate (7). Functions as a +2 quarterstaff.

name: Wand of the Mirrored Spell
description: 5 charges, regained at dawn. As a reaction, spend one to reflect a spell of 6th level or lower back at its caster, using your own save DC.

name: Rod of the Spent Year
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to age or restore a creature or object by up to ten years, DC 17 Constitution save for a creature to resist.

name: Staff of the Shut Gate
description: 20 charges, regaining 2d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Counterspell (3), Dispel Magic (3), Antimagic Field (8) or Globe of Invulnerability (6).

name: The Final Argument
description: A towering obsidian staff with 20 charges (recharges 2d8+4 at midnight). Cast Disintegrate (6 charges), Power Word Kill (10 charges, auto-kills targets below 150 HP), or Wish (20 charges, staff shatters). Once per day as a bonus action, automatically Counterspell any spell of 5th level or lower with no check required. The staff hums with something that sounds like a closing door.

name: The Argument Absolute
description: 25 charges, regaining 2d10+5 at dawn. Spend charges for Disintegrate (6), Power Word Stun (7), Power Word Kill (9) or Wish (20, after which the staff shatters).

name: Staff of the Nine Gates
description: 20 charges, regaining 2d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Teleport (7), Plane Shift (7) or Gate (9). You always arrive exactly where you intended.

name: Rod of the Unwritten Hour
description: 3 charges, regaining 1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Time Stop, or all three to rewind the last ten minutes for everyone but yourself.

name: The Shepherd's Crook of Kings
description: 25 charges, regaining 2d10+5 at dawn. Spend charges for Mass Suggestion (6), Dominate Monster (8) or Mass Dominate, affecting up to six creatures within 60 feet (12). Save DC 20.

name: Staff of the Drowned World
description: 25 charges, regaining 2d10+5 at dawn. Spend charges for Tsunami (8), Control Weather (8) or Storm of Vengeance (9). You are immune to cold and lightning.

name: The Lorekeeper's Rod
description: You know the answer to any question about an event more than one year past, asked once per day. The rod has never been wrong and never volunteers more than asked.

name: Staff of the Burning Throne
description: 25 charges, regaining 2d10+5 at dawn. Spend charges for Incendiary Cloud (8), Meteor Swarm (9) or Fire Storm (7). You are immune to fire and shed bright light in 30 feet at will.

name: The Unmaking Rod
description: 7 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. Spend one to disintegrate any nonmagical object instantly, or five to destroy a magic item of Rare or lower rarity permanently.

name: Staff of the Standing Dead
description: 25 charges, regaining 2d10+5 at dawn. Spend charges for Create Undead (6), Finger of Death (7), Resurrection (7) or True Resurrection (9).

name: The Severing Wand
description: 5 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. Spend one to end any ongoing magical effect of any level within 120 feet, no check and no save. Even divine magic yields.

name: The Last Staff
description: A plain length of grey wood. Once, and only once, it will do exactly what its holder most needs it to do, at the DM's discretion. Then it is kindling.

name: Draught of the First Step
description: Drinking this clear liquid grants advantage on your next Initiative roll and adds 10 feet to your movement for the first round of combat. Brewed from stimulant herbs grown in the outer reaches, and banned in DOL-controlled markets without a writ.

name: Potion of Ironblood
description: Drinking this potion grants resistance to one damage type of your choice for 1 minute. It is thick and metallic-tasting. The DOL distributes these to soldiers before engagements — which tells you something about how those engagements tend to go.

name: Vial of the Second Wind
description: Restores 2d4+4 hit points when drunk. As a bonus action, you can pour it on a creature at 0 hit points to stabilise them instead. It smells faintly of copper and something floral.

name: Draught of Shallow Sleep
description: Drink to fall asleep within one minute and wake refreshed after exactly four hours. You cannot be woken early by anything short of damage.

name: Tincture of the Closed Wound
description: Regain 2d4+2 hit points. If you are at 0 hit points when it is administered, you stabilise but regain no hit points.

name: Oil of the Quiet Hinge
description: Applied to any mechanism, it silences it completely for one hour. One flask treats a door, a lock, or a suit of armour.

name: Vial of Clear Lungs
description: For one hour you can breathe freely in smoke, dust and foul air, and you have advantage on saves against inhaled poisons.

name: Brewer's Honest Pint
description: Drink to remove one level of exhaustion caused by lack of food, water or sleep. It works only once per day and tastes dreadful.

name: Elixir of the Settled Hand
description: For ten minutes, you have advantage on Dexterity checks requiring fine control: picking locks, forgery, surgery or threading a needle.

name: Philtre of the Warm Hearth
description: You are immune to the effects of cold weather for eight hours and have advantage on saves against cold damage for the first hour.

name: Oil of the Keen Edge
description: Applied to one weapon, it deals an extra 1 damage on each hit for one hour. It does not stack with magical bonuses.

name: Draught of the Opened Eye
description: For one hour you gain darkvision to 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet instead.

name: Vial of the Turned Stomach
description: Induces violent vomiting within one round, expelling any ingested poison or substance taken in the last ten minutes.

name: Tonic of the Lesser Mending
description: Regain 1d8 hit points, and one nonmagical wound stops bleeding permanently. Broken bones remain broken.

name: Essence of the Blank Face
description: For one hour, your features become utterly forgettable. Observers cannot describe you afterwards beyond your approximate height.

name: Flask of Walking Water
description: For ten minutes you can walk across still water as though it were solid ground. Rough water, waves or rapids end the effect.

name: Syrup of the Long March
description: You may march for an additional four hours beyond your normal limit without risking exhaustion. Drinking a second within a day has no effect.

name: Draught of Loosened Tongues
description: A creature that drinks willingly becomes talkative and indiscreet for ten minutes, though it will not reveal what it holds genuinely sacred.

name: Oil of the Shed Grip
description: Coat yourself or an object. For ten minutes, checks to grapple or hold you are made with disadvantage. You also drop things constantly.

name: Vial of the Steady Flame
description: Poured onto any fire, it burns for eight hours without fuel and cannot be extinguished by wind or rain.

name: Cordial of the Clear Head
description: Instantly removes all effects of alcohol, nonmagical drugs and sleep deprivation. The clarity is merciless.

name: Tincture of Small Courage
description: For ten minutes you have advantage on saves against being Frightened, and you gain 5 temporary hit points.

name: Oil of the Slipped Lock
description: Poured into a keyhole, it grants advantage on the next check made to pick that lock, and the attempt makes no sound.

name: Draught of the Mended Voice
description: Restores a lost, hoarse or damaged voice instantly, and for one hour your voice carries twice as far and clearly.

name: Vial of Caught Light
description: Glows as a torch for six hours once uncorked. The light is cold, cannot be doused, and the empty vial is worthless.

name: Elixir of the Sure Stomach
description: For 24 hours you can eat and drink anything organic without harm, including spoiled food and brackish water.

name: Philtre of the Light Step
description: For ten minutes your footfalls leave no trace and make no sound on natural ground.

name: Salve of the Closed Burn
description: Heals all burns and scalds instantly, removing any ongoing fire damage. Does not restore hit points lost to the original burn.

name: Draught of the Patient Breath
description: You can hold your breath for one hour. The effect ends if you speak, and the potion tastes of still pond water.

name: Vial of the Washed Scent
description: Removes all trace of your scent for six hours. Creatures tracking you by smell automatically fail to do so.

name: Tonic of the Woken Mind
description: Ends the Unconscious condition on a creature with at least 1 hit point, and grants advantage on its next saving throw against sleep or charm.

name: Oil of the Rustbreaker
description: Restores one rusted, seized or corroded metal object to working order. One flask treats a sword, a lock or a hinge.

name: Draught of the Borrowed Hour
description: For one minute your walking speed increases by 10 feet. At the end you must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution save or be winded, losing your bonus action next turn.

name: Essence of the Cold Nerve
description: For ten minutes, you feel no pain. You have advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration, but take an extra 1 damage from each hit as you ignore your wounds.

name: Vial of Settled Dust
description: Thrown, it clears all smoke, dust and fog from a 20-foot radius instantly. The air remains clear for one minute.

name: Cordial of the Fed Belly
description: Counts as a full day's food and water. Drinking more than one in a day causes nausea and no further benefit.

name: Oil of the Quenched Blade
description: Applied to a weapon, it absorbs the next 5 fire damage that weapon or its wielder would take. One use.

name: Moonpetal Tincture
description: Brewed from flowers that bloom only at night, this banned lunar concoction restores 4d4+8 hit points and grants darkvision out to 60 feet for 8 hours — or doubles existing darkvision range. The DOL burns moonpetal fields whenever they find them.

name: Potion of the Long Shadow
description: For 1 hour after drinking, your shadow becomes detached and acts as a distraction — any creature that would attack you must first succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or attack the shadow instead (1 HP, AC 10). The shadow vanishes if destroyed or when the effect ends.

name: Elixir of Borrowed Speed
description: For 1 minute after drinking, gain an additional action each turn usable only for Attack (one attack), Dash, Disengage, or Use an Object. When the effect ends, you gain one level of Exhaustion. Worth it, usually.

name: Potion of Greater Mending
description: Regain 4d4+4 hit points. If you are at 0 hit points, you also stand up with no movement cost.

name: Draught of the Stone Skin
description: For ten minutes you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons. Your speed drops by 10 feet.

name: Elixir of the Thief's Hour
description: For ten minutes you have advantage on Stealth checks, and you can squeeze through any gap wide enough for your head.

name: Philtre of the Second Wind
description: Immediately regain all expended Hit Dice up to half your level, and remove one level of exhaustion.

name: Potion of the Climbing Vine
description: For one hour you gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed and can climb difficult surfaces without a check.

name: Draught of Borrowed Strength
description: For one hour your Strength becomes 19 if it is not already higher. The following day you have disadvantage on Strength checks.

name: Vial of Liquid Shadow
description: For one minute you are heavily obscured to all creatures that rely on sight, as though in dim light of your own making.

name: Tincture of the Unbroken Mind
description: Ends the Charmed, Frightened or Confused condition, and grants immunity to all three for ten minutes.

name: Oil of Silvering
description: Coats one weapon or ten pieces of ammunition. For one hour they count as silvered and magical for overcoming resistance.

name: Potion of the Diver's Lung
description: For one hour you can breathe water, see clearly underwater, and swim at your full walking speed.

name: Elixir of the Mirrored Self
description: For one minute, an illusory duplicate stands beside you. The first attack that would hit you strikes the duplicate instead.

name: Draught of Quickened Blood
description: For one minute you may take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action. You then gain one level of exhaustion.

name: Potion of the Small Form
description: For ten minutes you shrink one size category. Your Strength checks and weapon damage suffer disadvantage, but Stealth and squeezing improve greatly.

name: Potion of the Great Form
description: For ten minutes you grow one size category, dealing an extra 1d4 damage with melee weapons and gaining advantage on Strength checks.

name: Vial of the Turned Element
description: Name acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder when you drink. You gain resistance to that damage for ten minutes.

name: Philtre of Spoken Beasts
description: For one hour you can speak with and understand any Beast. They are no friendlier for it, merely comprehensible.

name: Draught of the Risen Dead
description: Administered to a creature dead for less than one minute, it returns with 1 hit point. It cannot be used on the same creature twice in a week.

name: Oil of the Burning Edge
description: Applied to a weapon, it deals an extra 1d6 fire damage for one hour and sheds light as a candle.

name: Elixir of the Honest Sight
description: For ten minutes you see through illusions of 3rd level or lower automatically, and can see invisible creatures within 30 feet.

name: Potion of the Light Body
description: For one hour you fall at 60 feet per round and take no falling damage, and you can jump three times your normal distance.

name: Draught of the Fixed Purpose
description: For one hour you automatically succeed on Concentration saves from damage of 10 or less, and cannot be Charmed.

name: Tonic of the Purged Vein
description: Neutralises all poison in the drinker and ends the Poisoned condition. Grants immunity to poison for one hour.

name: Vial of Gathered Thunder
description: Thrown as an action within 30 feet. Creatures in a 10-foot radius take 3d6 thunder damage, DC 13 Constitution save for half and not Deafened.

name: Elixir of the Grafted Skill
description: Name one skill when you drink. For one hour you are proficient in it, or gain expertise if already proficient.

name: Potion of the Waking Watch
description: For eight hours you do not need to sleep, cannot be put to sleep magically, and suffer no penalty for staying awake.

name: Draught of the Ironbound Gut
description: For 24 hours you are immune to poison and disease, and you can digest literally anything, including metal and glass.

name: Oil of Spider Climbing
description: For one hour you can move on vertical surfaces and ceilings, leaving your hands free.

name: Philtre of the Forked Path
description: For one minute, whenever you make an ability check, roll twice and take either result. You may not do this for attack rolls or saves.

name: Vial of the Held Flame
description: Grants immunity to nonmagical fire and resistance to magical fire for ten minutes. Your skin glows faintly orange throughout.

name: Elixir of the Lesser Restoration
description: Ends one disease, or one of the Blinded, Deafened, Paralysed or Poisoned conditions affecting the drinker.

name: Shadowsong Draught
description: A black liquid recovered from Shadowsong caches. For 10 minutes, you can move through solid matter as though it weren't there (cannot end turn inside it) and have advantage on all Dexterity saving throws. The liquid is ice-cold going down and leaves no taste.

name: Potion of the Unbroken Mind
description: Grants immunity to the Charmed, Frightened, and Stunned conditions for 1 hour and immediately ends any ongoing versions of those conditions. It tastes like the smell of clean air after long rain.

name: Draught of the Counted Hour
description: For one minute you know precisely what every creature within 30 feet will do on its next turn, granting advantage on your first attack each round.

name: Potion of Superior Mending
description: Regain 8d4+8 hit points. If this brings you to your hit point maximum, you also gain 10 temporary hit points for one hour.

name: Elixir of the Borrowed Shape
description: For one hour, transform into any Beast of CR 2 or lower, as the Polymorph spell cast upon yourself. You retain your mental statistics.

name: Draught of the Stopped Clock
description: For one minute you are Hasted, as the spell, with no concentration required and no lethargy afterwards.

name: Vial of the Hollow Step
description: For ten minutes you can pass through solid objects up to 5 feet thick. Ending your turn inside one deals 6d6 force damage and expels you.

name: Philtre of the Open Mind
description: For one hour you can read the surface thoughts of creatures within 30 feet, with a DC 15 Wisdom save to resist.

name: Elixir of the Turned Spell
description: For one minute you have advantage on all saving throws against spells, and a spell of 3rd level or lower that targets only you fails once.

name: Potion of the Invisible Hour
description: You become invisible for one hour. Unlike most such magic, attacking does not end the effect, though it does reveal your position.

name: Draught of the Iron Oath
description: For ten minutes you cannot be reduced below 1 hit point, but at the end you take all damage you prevented, which may kill you.

name: Vial of Liquid Night
description: Thrown, it fills a 30-foot radius with magical darkness for ten minutes. The drinker instead gains the ability to see through all darkness for one hour.

name: Elixir of the Shared Wound
description: Split between two creatures. For one hour, all damage either takes is divided evenly between them, and healing is likewise shared.

name: Potion of the Giant's Due
description: For one hour your Strength becomes 23, you count as one size larger for carrying and grappling, and your melee attacks deal an extra 1d8 damage.

name: Draught of the Fourfold Sight
description: For one hour you gain truesight to 60 feet. The drinker's eyes turn glassy white and remain so for a day afterwards.

name: Tonic of the Greater Purge
description: Ends all diseases, poisons, curses of 3rd level or lower, and every condition affecting the drinker short of death.

name: Oil of the Keenest Edge
description: Applied to a weapon, it becomes +2 for one hour and scores critical hits on a 19 or 20.

name: Elixir of the Unspent Breath
description: For 24 hours you need not breathe, eat, drink or sleep, and you are immune to suffocation, drowning and vacuum.

name: Philtre of the Stolen Face
description: Take on the exact appearance, voice and build of a creature whose hair or blood is mixed into the vial. Lasts eight hours; truesight sees through it.

name: Draught of the Waking Dead
description: Poured on a corpse dead no more than ten days, it rises as a Zombie under your control for 24 hours.

name: Vial of Caught Lightning
description: Thrown within 60 feet, it strikes all creatures in a 20-foot radius for 6d6 lightning damage, DC 15 Dexterity save for half.

name: Elixir of the Steady Soul
description: For 24 hours you cannot be possessed, banished, polymorphed or have your form altered against your will.

name: Potion of the Doubled Hour
description: For one minute, you take two turns each round, acting on your initiative and again at initiative minus 10. You then gain two levels of exhaustion.

name: Draught of the Unseen Road
description: For ten minutes you may teleport up to 30 feet as a bonus action on each of your turns, to any space you can see.

name: Vial of the Rising Flame
description: For ten minutes you are wreathed in fire: immune to fire damage, shedding bright light in 20 feet, and dealing 1d10 fire damage to any creature that touches or grapples you.

name: Elixir of the Lent Year
description: Reduces the drinker's apparent and biological age by 1d10 years, to a minimum of adulthood. It can be drunk only once in a lifetime; the second dose does nothing.

name: Philtre of the Compelled Truth
description: A creature that drinks must succeed on a DC 15 Charisma save or be unable to speak a deliberate lie for ten minutes. It may still refuse to speak.

name: Draught of the Hundred Hands
description: For one minute, you may make one additional attack whenever you take the Attack action, and you may use two bonus actions each turn.

name: Crucible Draught
description: For 1 minute after drinking, your melee attacks deal an extra 3d6 fire damage. Any creature you hit must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution save or be unable to regain hit points until the start of your next turn. The bottle is always hot to the touch.

name: Potion of Eclipse Vision
description: For 8 hours, you see through all illusions automatically, perceive invisible creatures and objects, and read the aura of any creature within 30 feet — knowing its type and current emotional state at a glance. The DOL offers a standing bounty for the recipe.

name: Potion of the Final Mending
description: Regain all hit points, end all conditions short of death, and regrow one lost limb or organ over the following minute.

name: Elixir of the Walked Plane
description: Drink to cast Plane Shift on yourself alone, arriving at a destination you can clearly name. One use.

name: Draught of the Unending Minute
description: Time stops for everyone but you for three rounds. Anything you do that affects another creature ends the effect immediately.

name: Vial of the Second Body
description: Creates a perfect duplicate of you with your statistics and hit points, lasting one hour. If either dies, the other continues unharmed.

name: Philtre of the Dragon's Due
description: For ten minutes you gain a flying speed of 60 feet, resistance to one damage type of your choice, and a breath weapon dealing 8d6 of that type in a 30-foot cone, usable twice.

name: Elixir of the Unbound Mind
description: For one hour your Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma each become 21 if not already higher, and you have advantage on all mental saving throws.

name: Potion of the Mirrored Fate
description: For one minute, any creature that damages you takes the same damage it dealt, of the same type, with no save.

name: Draught of the Hollow King
description: For one hour you become undead: immune to poison and necrotic damage, unable to be healed by positive energy, and you no longer need to breathe.

name: Vial of the Unwritten Hour
description: Drink to undo the last minute entirely. All creatures return to their positions and hit points of sixty seconds ago. Only you remember.

name: Elixir of the Perfect Form
description: For one hour, transform into any creature of CR 6 or lower, gaining its physical statistics and abilities while keeping your mind.

name: Philtre of the Sealed Soul
description: For 24 hours you cannot die: damage that would kill you leaves you at 1 hit point. When the hour ends, you take all damage you avoided at once.

name: Draught of the Thousand Eyes
description: For one hour you perceive everything within 300 feet regardless of cover, darkness, invisibility or illusion. You cannot be Surprised or flanked.

name: Potion of the Turned Season
description: For one hour you have immunity to fire and cold damage, and may alter the temperature within 60 feet by up to fifty degrees at will.

name: Vial of the Gathered Storm
description: Thrown, it calls a storm in a 60-foot radius for one minute: 4d8 lightning damage to a random creature in the area each round, DC 17 Dexterity save for half.

name: Elixir of the Returned Dead
description: Poured into the mouth of a creature dead no more than ten days, it returns to life with full hit points, as the Raise Dead spell with no cost.

name: Draught of the Spent Lifetime
description: For ten minutes you gain a +4 bonus to all attack rolls, saving throws and ability checks. Afterwards you age 1d10 years permanently.

name: Philtre of the Opened Gate
description: Drink to become attuned to a place you have visited. For 24 hours you may teleport there as an action from anywhere on this plane.

name: Potion of the Unmade Wound
description: Removes all curses, diseases, poisons and magical effects on the drinker, including those of 9th level, and restores all lost hit points.

name: The Last Draught
description: When consumed, regain all hit points, all expended spell slots and class features, and end all conditions. For the next 24 hours you cannot die — dropping to 0 hit points instead restores 50 HP and forces nearby enemies to make a DC 20 Wisdom save or flee. This potion can only be brewed once per century. The vial is always found empty; it refills at the next solar eclipse.

name: The Last Breath
description: Drunk at 0 hit points, you return to full health, all conditions end, and you gain immunity to all damage for one minute. There is no second dose.

name: Elixir of the Unspent Life
description: Your maximum hit points increase permanently by 20, and you gain a permanent +1 to all saving throws. Only one such elixir ever takes effect per creature.

name: Draught of the Ninth Door
description: Cast Gate as a 9th-level spell, opening a portal to any plane you can name for one minute. What comes through is not necessarily yours to command.

name: The Gilded Hour
description: For one hour you cannot fail: every attack roll, saving throw and ability check you make is treated as a 20. Afterwards you gain four levels of exhaustion.

name: Philtre of the Rewritten Self
description: Permanently raise one ability score of your choice by 2, to a maximum of 22, and remove one permanent injury, curse or affliction.

name: Elixir of the Standing Year
description: You cease aging permanently. You are immune to disease, poison and death from old age, and you require no food, drink or sleep ever again.

name: The Shared Soul
description: Split between two willing creatures. Thereafter, while both live, neither can die while the other is conscious, and each knows the other's condition at all times. Permanent.

name: Draught of the Open Eye of the World
description: For 24 hours you have truesight to one mile, can see into the Ethereal and Astral planes, and know the true name of every creature you look upon.

name: The Unmaking Draught
description: Thrown at a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution save or be reduced to 0 hit points and disintegrated along with everything it carries.

name: Elixir of the Borrowed Crown
description: For one hour, all creatures of CR 5 or lower within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom save or obey your commands as though Charmed.

name: The Patient Cure
description: Cures any single affliction, no matter its origin: lycanthropy, undeath, petrification, a god's curse, or a transformation thought permanent. One use, and only one works per creature.

name: Dustbone Flute
description: A flute carved from hollow bone. When played during a short rest, creatures of your choice who hear it regain an additional 1d4 hit points from Hit Dice spent. The melody is simple and a little mournful, and travellers in the outer reaches learn it young.

name: Drum of the Marching Dead
description: When this drum is played, undead that can hear it move in time with the rhythm, reducing their speed by 10 feet. The effect lasts as long as you play (concentration, no spell). Disturbing but useful in graveyards.

name: Tin Whistle of the Short Road
description: Played while walking, it eases the miles. You and up to five companions ignore the first hour of fatigue on any day's march.

name: Cracked Bodhran
description: A hand drum with a split skin. Its beat carries for a mile and can be heard through walls, though it conveys no words.

name: Shepherd's Reed Pipe
description: Ordinary animals within 60 feet grow calm and will not startle while you play. They are not charmed, merely unbothered.

name: Cup-and-String Fiddle
description: A beggar's instrument. You have advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks made to earn coin in a public place.

name: Bone Flute of the Low Hills
