description: Played at dusk, it keeps vermin, insects and scavengers from a camp for the whole night.

name: Watchman's Handbell
description: Rung once, every creature within 300 feet hears it clearly, however loud their surroundings. It cannot be muffled.

name: Child's Painted Lyre
description: Simple and brightly painted. Children and creatures of animal intelligence that hear it will not willingly leave earshot while you play.

name: Cooper's Tapping Mallet
description: Struck against any vessel, the note reveals how full it is and whether it has a false bottom.

name: Funeral Rattle
description: Shaken over a corpse, it keeps the body from rot, scavengers and reanimation for seven days.

name: Harvest Horn
description: Sounded over a field or larder, it tells you precisely how much food is present and how long it will last a given number of mouths.

name: Waterlogged Concertina
description: It plays perfectly well underwater, where the sound carries three times as far as it would in air.

name: Rushcutter's Jaw Harp
description: Twanged once, it reveals the direction of the nearest open water within one mile.

name: Mourning Chime
description: Rings of its own accord, once, whenever someone you have named by name dies anywhere in the world. It gives no other information.

name: Carter's Whistling Spoons
description: A pair of wooden spoons. Played together, they make it impossible for anyone within 30 feet to fall asleep, willing or not.

name: Hedge Fiddle of Small Cheer
description: Ten minutes of play grants everyone who listens 1d4 temporary hit points, once per long rest each.

name: Drover's Clapper
description: Herd animals within 100 feet move in the direction you indicate while you play. They will not be driven into obvious danger.

name: Glass Bell of the Clear Note
description: Rung near any magical illusion of 1st level or lower, it cracks the illusion visibly for one round. It cannot dispel.

name: Sailor's Squeezebox
description: Played on deck, the crew works at double speed for one hour. It has no effect on anyone not engaged in labour.

name: Hollow-Log Drum
description: Beaten on the ground, it reveals whether there is a cavity, tunnel or buried chamber within 30 feet beneath you.

name: Beggar's Comb-and-Paper
description: An improvised kazoo. While you play, those who hear you find it impossible to take you seriously, granting advantage on checks to seem harmless.

name: Miner's Tuning Fork
description: Struck against stone, the ring tells you the kind of rock, whether it bears ore, and how thick the seam runs.

name: Wind-Chime of the Turning Hour
description: Hung in the open, it chimes once at each hour of the day and three times at midnight, regardless of wind.

name: Thatcher's Pan-Pipes
description: Played before weather turns, the pipes sound a sour note. You always know the weather for the coming twelve hours.

name: Lullaby Box
description: A wind-up music box. A creature of Small size or smaller that hears it must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom save or doze for one minute, waking at any disturbance.

name: Cracked Churchbell Handle
description: A length of bell-rope. Pulled, it sounds a distant bell audible for two miles that nobody can locate the source of.

name: Fletcher's Humming Bow
description: A single-string bow played with a horsehair. Its note makes nearby bowstrings sing in sympathy, revealing hidden archers within 60 feet.

name: Sexton's Rattle-Staff
description: Shaken, all creatures within 30 feet know unerringly which way is the nearest exit from any enclosed space.

name: Potboy's Spoon-Bells
description: You have advantage on Charisma checks made to be served, seated or attended in any inn, tavern or kitchen.

name: Cobweb Harp
description: Strung with fine grey thread. Played in a room, it reveals every hidden door and false panel by resonance, though not how to open them.

name: Nightwatch Ocarina
description: Those who hear it while on watch cannot fall asleep at their post and gain advantage on Perception checks for one hour.

name: Scrimshaw Flute
description: Carved from whalebone. Played at sea, it calms the water within 100 feet to a flat swell for ten minutes.

name: Peddler's Cymbals
description: Crashed together, every creature within 60 feet looks at you involuntarily. This is often exactly what you wanted and occasionally a mistake.

name: Threadbare Bagpipe
description: Deeply unpleasant. Creatures within 30 feet that can hear it have disadvantage on Stealth checks, as they cannot help but wince.

name: Dowser's Humming Rod
description: Hums when carried within 50 feet of fresh water, rising in pitch as you draw nearer. It is silent near salt or foul water.

name: Lute of the Wandering Story
description: This lute stores the last 3 performances played on it and can replay them perfectly on command. When assisting a Persuasion or Performance check, expend one stored performance to grant advantage to an ally's Charisma check within earshot. It has played things no one asked it to.

name: Harp of the Veil
description: When played, this small harp can cast Calm Emotions (DC 13) once per day. Spirits and ghosts who hear it are compelled to approach rather than flee. Recovered from a Shadowsong sympathiser's estate — the original owner used it to speak with the dead.

name: Horn of the Outer Reaches
description: Sounding this horn creates a peal audible for 3 miles. All creatures within 60 feet not allied with you must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom save or be Frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Can be sounded once per hour.

name: Lute of the Wandering Road
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Charm Person, Sleep or Disguise Self as part of a performance. Save DC 13.

name: Horn of the Gathered Hound
description: Once per day, sound it to summon four spectral hounds with Wolf statistics. They fight for ten minutes and obey simple commands.

name: Harp of Quiet Waters
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Calm Emotions or Sleep as part of a performance. Save DC 13.

name: Drum of the Set Pace
description: While you play, allies within 30 feet gain 10 feet of movement speed and cannot be slowed by nonmagical means.

name: Bell of the Turned Dead
description: Once per short rest, ring it to force all Undead within 30 feet to make a DC 13 Wisdom save or flee from you for one minute.

name: Fiddle of the Red Dance
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to force a creature within 30 feet to make a DC 13 Wisdom save or dance helplessly for one minute, unable to take actions.

name: Pipes of the Shut Door
description: Once per day, play to seal a doorway or passage up to 10 feet wide with hardened air for ten minutes. It has AC 15 and 30 hit points.

name: Shawm of the Carried Word
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Sending as part of a short tune. The recipient hears your message as music.

name: Hurdy-Gurdy of the Long Night
description: Play for ten minutes to grant everyone who listens the benefit of a short rest without spending Hit Dice. Once per long rest.

name: Tambour of the Rallied Line
description: Once per short rest, as an action, grant up to six allies within 30 feet 2d6 temporary hit points and immunity to Frightened for one minute.

name: Chime of the Opened Lock
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Knock. The chime rings a pure note that cannot be mistaken for anything else.

name: Viol of the Mirrored Mood
description: While you play, you may set the emotional tone of a room. Creatures within 60 feet have disadvantage on Insight checks to read anyone's true feelings, including yours.

name: Horn of the Broken Wall
description: Once per day, sound it at a structure within 30 feet: 4d8 thunder damage to objects and structures, which usually suffices for a door.

name: Reed Pipes of the Snake Charmer
description: Beasts and Monstrosities of CR 2 or lower within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or be Charmed while you play and for one minute after.

name: Cittern of the Borrowed Tongue
description: While you play, you can speak and be understood by any creature that can hear, regardless of language. They cannot reply in kind.

name: Gong of the Settled Dust
description: Once per short rest, strike it to clear all gas, fog, smoke and airborne effects from a 30-foot radius instantly.

name: Rebec of the Grey Hour
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Silent Image or Invisibility on yourself as part of a performance.

name: Kettle-Drum of the Marching Dead
description: Once per day, beat it to raise 1d4 Skeletons from any ground where bodies lie. They serve for one hour then collapse.

name: Flute of the Lifted Veil
description: While you play, invisible creatures within 30 feet are faintly outlined and have disadvantage on Stealth checks.

name: Bodhran of the Steady Heart
description: Allies within 30 feet who can hear it have advantage on Constitution saves to maintain Concentration while you play.

name: Trumpet of the Called Watch
description: Once per day, sound it to alert every ally within one mile to your exact location and whether you are in danger.

name: Lyre of the Raised Wall
description: Once per day, play for one minute to raise a crude wall of stone, earth or timber 20 feet long and 10 feet high. It is permanent but unlovely.

name: Sistrum of the Shaken Spell
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to force a creature Concentrating within 30 feet to make a DC 13 Constitution save or lose it.

name: Nyckelharpa of the Long Memory
description: Any song, speech or sound you have heard in the last month can be reproduced by this instrument exactly, voices included.

name: Panpipes of the Thin Air
description: Once per day, play to create a 20-foot radius of breathable air for ten minutes, underwater, in smoke or in vacuum.

name: Dulcimer of the Soft Step
description: While you play, you and allies within 15 feet make no sound when moving and have advantage on Stealth checks. You must keep playing.

name: Carillon of the Counted Hour
description: Once per day, ring it to know precisely what happened in this exact spot at this hour on the previous day.

name: Horn of the Scattered Flock
description: Once per short rest, all creatures of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or be pushed 15 feet directly away from you.

name: Harp of the Mended Mind
description: Ten minutes of play ends one Charmed, Frightened or Confused condition on each listener, and grants advantage against such effects for the next hour.

name: Shruti Box of the Held Note
description: Once wound, it sustains a single drone for one hour without attention. Creatures that fall asleep to it gain a full long rest in six hours.

name: Whistle of the Returned Beast
description: Attune one animal companion or mount. Blown anywhere within five miles, it comes to you by the fastest route it can manage.

name: Moonchime Bell
description: A banned lunar instrument whose tone matches frequencies used in Shadowsong communication. When rung under moonlight, cast Sending to any creature you name. Once per day, ringing it dispels all active illusions within 60 feet. The DOL melts these down when found.

name: Echo Vein Singing Bowl
description: When struck, this crystal bowl resonates with Echo Vein frequencies. Creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom save or have their surface thoughts briefly readable — you know if they intend to lie for the next minute. Once per day, cast Detect Thoughts (DC 14) without concentration.

name: Strings of Binding
description: A violin strung with something that isn't quite gut. When played, choose a creature within 30 feet that can hear you — they must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be Restrained for as long as you play (concentration, max 1 minute). Each turn as a bonus action, you can extend the effect to one additional creature.

name: The Shriven Lute
description: 6 charges, regaining 1d4+2 at dawn. Spend charges for Suggestion (2), Hypnotic Pattern (3), Fear (3) or Confusion (4). Save DC 15.

name: Carillon of the Sundered Spell
description: 4 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Dispel Magic at 3rd level, or two to cast Counterspell as a reaction.

name: Drum of the Standing Host
description: Once per day, beat it for one minute to summon eight spectral soldiers with Guard statistics. They fight for ten minutes and follow simple orders.

name: Harp of the Hollow Hill
description: 6 charges, regaining 1d4+2 at dawn. Spend charges for Sleep at 5th level (3), Dream (5) or Modify Memory (5). Save DC 15.

name: Horn of the Broken Siege
description: Once per day, sound it in a 60-foot cone: 6d8 thunder damage, DC 15 Constitution save for half, and all structures and objects in the area take double.

name: Viol of the Given Grief
description: Once per day, play for one minute. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear must make a DC 15 Wisdom save or be Incapacitated by sorrow for one minute.

name: Bell of the Unmade Curse
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast Remove Curse, or all three to end a curse of 6th level or lower.

name: Pipes of the Rat King
description: Once per day, summon a swarm of rats that fills a 20-foot radius and obeys you for ten minutes. In a city, the swarm is three times as large.

name: Fiddle of the Last Reel
description: Once per day, force all creatures within 30 feet to make a DC 15 Wisdom save or dance uncontrollably for one minute, taking 2d6 exhaustion damage each round.

name: Lyre of the Standing Stone
description: 6 charges, regaining 1d4+2 at dawn. Spend charges for Wall of Stone (5), Move Earth (6) or Stone Shape (4). A structure so built lasts a century.

name: Trumpet of the Turned Host
description: Once per day, all Undead and Fiends within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be Turned for one minute. Those of CR 1 or lower are destroyed.

name: Shawm of the Shared Wound
description: Once per day, play for one minute to link all willing allies within 30 feet: damage to any one of them is divided evenly among them all for ten minutes.

name: The Hollow Organ Pipe
description: A single salvaged pipe. Once per day, its note creates a 30-foot sphere of absolute silence that moves with you for ten minutes. No magic penetrates it.

name: Hurdy-Gurdy of the Grey March
description: While you play, allies within 60 feet ignore exhaustion, cannot be Frightened, and add 1d6 to all saving throws. You may play for ten minutes per day.

name: Chime of the Opened Eye
description: 4 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one to cast See Invisibility, two for Clairvoyance, or three for True Seeing on yourself.

name: Drum of the Rising Water
description: 6 charges, regaining 1d4+2 at dawn. Spend charges for Tidal Wave (3), Control Water (4) or Wall of Water (3).

name: Bone Flute of the Called Dead
description: 4 charges, regained at dawn. Spend one for Speak with Dead, or three for Animate Dead. The flute is cold to the touch for an hour after.

name: Citole of the Turned Crowd
description: Once per day, play for one minute before a crowd. All who hear must make a DC 15 Charisma save or adopt your stated opinion for 24 hours.

name: Gong of the Stopped Heart
description: Once per day, strike it at a creature within 30 feet: DC 15 Constitution save or be Stunned for one minute, repeating at the end of each of its turns.

name: Psaltery of the Mended Flesh
description: 6 charges, regaining 1d4+2 at dawn. Spend charges for Mass Cure Wounds (5), Revivify (3) or Greater Restoration (5).

name: Horn of the Lost Road
description: Once per day, sound it to transport yourself and up to five willing creatures within 10 feet to any place you have visited within 100 miles.

name: The Weeping Bell
description: Rung over a dying creature, it holds death at bay: the creature is stable and cannot die for one hour, however grievous the wound. Once per day.

name: Lute of the Thousand Faces
description: 6 charges, regaining 1d4+2 at dawn. Spend charges for Seeming (5), Major Image (3) or Mislead (5).

name: Tabor of the Second Wind
description: Once per short rest, all allies within 30 feet may immediately spend one Hit Die and regain that many hit points plus your Charisma modifier.

name: The Silent Harp
description: Produces no sound audible to any creature but its chosen target. Once per day, cast Dominate Person on a creature within 60 feet, DC 15, with no visible component.

name: Carnyx of the Risen Field
description: Once per day, sound it to grant all allies within 60 feet advantage on attack rolls and immunity to Frightened for one minute.

name: The Wailing Lute
description: A cracked lute that plays itself softly at midnight. In combat as a bonus action, expend a Bardic Inspiration die to cast Dissonant Whispers (DC 16) for free. While the lute is played, creatures affected by any of your spells take an extra 1d8 psychic damage per hit.

name: The Grand Organ of Pale Sorrow
description: A portable pipe organ requiring attunement by a bard or cleric. When played for at least 1 minute, all creatures within 300 feet that can hear it must make a DC 17 Wisdom save or be Incapacitated with grief for 1 minute (repeating each turn). Creatures that succeed are immune for 24 hours. The DOL confiscated the original — this is a copy.

name: The Grand Carillon
description: 12 charges, regaining 1d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Hold Monster (5), Dominate Person (5), Mass Suggestion (6) or Power Word Stun (7). Save DC 17.

name: Horn of the Broken Mountain
description: Once per day, sound it to collapse a structure or cliff face up to 60 feet across: 10d10 bludgeoning damage, DC 17 Dexterity save for half.

name: The Weeping Viol
description: Once per day, play for one minute. Every creature within 120 feet that can hear relives its worst memory: 8d8 psychic damage and Frightened for one minute, DC 17 Wisdom save for half and no fear.

name: Lyre of the Walked World
description: 12 charges, regaining 1d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Teleport (7), Plane Shift (7) or Transport via Plants (6).

name: Drum of the Hundred Dead
description: Once per day, beat it for one minute on ground where ten or more creatures died. They rise as Wights under your control until destroyed or until dawn.

name: The Sunrise Trumpet
description: Once per day, sound it to fill a 60-foot radius with true daylight for one hour. Undead and Fiends in the area take 6d8 radiant damage per round, DC 17 for half.

name: Harp of the Unwoven Hour
description: 3 charges, regaining 1 at dawn. Spend one to cast Slow or Haste on up to six creatures, or all three to cast Time Stop for two rounds.

name: Pipes of the Pied Procession
description: Once per day, all creatures of CR 4 or lower within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom save or follow you helplessly for one hour, or until harmed.

name: The Shattering Bell
description: Once per day, ring it to shatter all glass, crystal and unattended brittle objects within 300 feet, and deal 8d8 thunder damage in a 30-foot radius, DC 17 for half.

name: Organistrum of the Held World
description: 12 charges, regaining 1d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Forcecage (7), Wall of Force (5) or Antimagic Field (8).

name: The Mourner's Chime
description: Once per week, ring it over a creature dead no more than a year. It returns to life with full hit points, as True Resurrection, but remembers its death perfectly.

name: Cornet of the Called Storm
description: 12 charges, regaining 1d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Call Lightning (3), Chain Lightning (6) or Control Weather (8).

name: The Unsleeping Lyre
description: Plays itself endlessly once started. All who hear it need no sleep, cannot be magically slept or Charmed, and gain the benefit of a long rest in two hours.

name: Horn of the Seventh Gate
description: Once per week, sound it to open a portal to any plane for one minute. What arrives is not necessarily what you called.

name: The Rendering Fiddle
description: Once per day, play for one minute: choose up to six creatures within 60 feet. Each must make a DC 17 Constitution save or take 10d6 thunder damage and be Deafened for one hour.

name: Psaltery of the Perfect Hour
description: Play for ten minutes to grant everyone who listens the full benefit of a long rest, including recovered spell slots. Once per week.

name: The Gathering Gong
description: Once per day, strike it to summon every willing ally within ten miles to your side instantly. They arrive knowing why they were called.

name: Shawm of the Hollowed Will
description: Once per day, a creature within 60 feet must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom save or serve you faithfully for 24 hours, retaining its own personality and no memory of being compelled.

name: The Tidewrack Horn
description: Once per day, sound it over open water to raise a wave 40 feet high that travels 300 feet in a direction you choose. Creatures caught take 10d8 bludgeoning damage and are swept 60 feet, DC 17 Strength save for half and no movement.

name: The Midnight Instrument — Shadowsong's Last Voice
description: The recovered instrument of the last Shadowsong conductor, inlaid with lunar silver and Echo Vein shards. Once per day, performing for 1 minute casts a region-wide effect: all creatures within 1 mile that can hear it make a DC 20 Wisdom save. On a failure, they are subject to Modify Memory — the performer may replace one conversation-length memory per affected creature, spoken into the instrument beforehand. The DOL has classified this as a weapon of mass subversion. It has been 'destroyed' three times.

name: Trumpet of the Shattered Accord
description: When sounded as an action, this trumpet produces the exact sound of the first bell that rang when Le'Choix fell to the Division of Lumination. All creatures within 500 feet that hear it must make a DC 21 Wisdom save or be Paralysed for 1 minute (repeating each turn on failure). Undead and constructs are immune. The player takes 2d10 psychic damage — the weight of history. Usable once per week.

name: Drum of the Waking Army
description: When beaten for 1 uninterrupted minute, this war drum raises up to 20 Wight-statistic undead soldiers from any ground where more than 10 humanoids died. They obey your commands without limit and last until destroyed or until the next sunrise. Cannot be used again until the following midnight. The sound carries for miles, and people who hear it know — somehow — exactly what it means.

name: The Instrument of Kings
description: A gilded lyre. 20 charges, regaining 2d8+4 at dawn. Spend charges for Mass Suggestion (6), Dominate Monster (8), Power Word Kill (9) or Wish (20, destroying the lyre).

name: The Horn That Ends the Siege
description: Once per month, sound it: every wall, gate, door and fortification within one mile crumbles to rubble. Creatures within take 12d10 bludgeoning damage, DC 20 Dexterity save for half.

name: The Weeping Carillon
description: Once per week, ring it for one minute. Every creature within one mile that can hear weeps for an hour, unable to take hostile action. Even gods are said to pause.

name: Drum of the Risen Legion
description: Once per week, beat it for ten minutes over a battlefield. Up to one hundred dead rise as Skeletons and Zombies under your command for 24 hours.

name: The Last Lullaby
description: Once per day, play for one minute. All creatures within 120 feet must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution save or fall asleep for one hour, waking only to damage. There is no hit point limit.

name: The Sundering Organ
description: A portable pipe organ, immovable once set. Its chord deals 20d10 thunder damage in a 120-foot cone, DC 20 Constitution save for half. Once per week, and it takes a minute to play.

name: Lyre of the Rebuilt World
description: Play for one hour to rebuild any structure within sight exactly as it stood at any point in the past, down to the furniture. Once per month.

name: The Trumpet of the Shut Gate
description: Once per week, sound it to banish every Fiend, Celestial, Elemental and Fey within one mile to its home plane, DC 20 Charisma save to resist.

name: The Memory Harp
description: Play any creature's name to hear its entire life recounted in song, truthfully, from birth to the present moment. Once per day, and the song takes as long as it takes.

name: The Bell of the Final Hour
description: Rung once, every creature within one mile knows exactly how and when it will die. They have disadvantage on all rolls for an hour. It may be rung once a year.

name: The First Instrument
description: A reed pipe, plain and very old. Any spell of 8th level or lower may be cast through it once per day without components or a spell slot, so long as the caster can play a tune.
